## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xying-lm/dsh-memory-vault.git
```

然后在 DSH 里把它装成一个 bundle：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target="file:<你的克隆路径>/dsh-memory-vault"
```

或直接在 GUI 里「设置 → 插件 → 安装插件」填入本地路径。

装好后**重启 DSH**（关窗口不算退出，托盘进程还在）：插件是 generation 快照拷贝，宿主启动时只 `import()` 一次，没有热重载通道。

默认库文件在 `D:\dsh-memory\vault.db`（macOS / Linux 落到 `~/.dsh-memory/vault.db`），可以在配置里改 `dbPath`。

## 七个工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | 在长期记忆里检索。支持中文整句当查询词，`offset` 可翻页。 |
| `memory_open` | 按 id 分段读一条记忆的全文（`chars` 控制每页字数，返回 `next` 接着读）。 |
| `memory_catalog` | 看库的整体目录：总条数、按天分布、最近的会话、时间跨度。 |
| `memory_save` | 显式记住一条（约定、偏好、关键决策）。默认长期；传 `mode: "multi"` 只本会话可见，`mode: "once"` 召回一次即删。 |
| `memory_stats` | 看用量：条数、占用、配额、当前档位、时间跨度。 |
| `memory_resize` | 改容量上限：给 `gigabytes: 5` 用常用档位，或 `2.5` 这样的自定义值（0.05~200）。立即生效、落库、重启不丢。 |
| `memory_forget` | 按 id 删掉一条（不可恢复）。 |

自动召回与这七个工具是**两条独立的路**：自动召回省事但可能漏，工具要模型主动调但问得准。两条都开着才稳。

### 三种记忆模式

| 模式 | 什么时候用 | 生命周期 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `long`（长期，默认） | 约定、偏好、关键决策、踩过的坑 | 永久保留，跨会话可召回 |
| `multi`（多次） | 「这个项目这周先这么办」这类**只在本会话有效**的口径 | 只在写入它的那个会话里可召回；12 小时后自动清理 |
| `once`（单次） | 一次性的口令、临时编号、只想说一遍的事 | 被自动召回**一次**就从库里删掉（连正文都不留） |

自动采集的两条配置决定「自动记下来的」算哪种：`captureMode`（默认 `long`）；手动 `memory_save` 时由你传的 `mode` 决定（默认 `defaultMode`）。`memory_stats` 会显示库里三种模式各有多少条。

#### 在对话里直接换模式

输入框那一行、**「完全权限」控件的右边**有一个 `记忆 长期 ▾` 的小按钮（座位 `conversation.input.left`）。点开是三个选项：

- **长期** — 永久保存，任何会话都能召回
- **本会话** — 只在这个会话可见，12 小时后清掉
- **单次** — 被召回一次就删除，不留痕

选完立刻生效：**之后**这个会话的自动采集、以及模型调用 `memory_save` 时没显式传 `mode` 的，都按这个模式存。它只作用于当前会话，且只存在内存里（重启回到默认 `captureMode`）——不是全局设置，所以不会悄悄改掉别的会话。

> 要全局默认值，还是改配置里的 `captureMode` / `defaultMode`；输入框里这个是「这个会话怎么记」的临时开关。

### 对话文件：一条线索一个文件

记忆库是「一堆碎片」，而人聊事情是按线索走的。所以每次会话都会挂到一个**对话文件**上：

- 第一条消息时自动新建一个 `.md`（存在库目录的 `threads\` 下），文件名带日期与短标题，会话从此归这条线索；
- 输入框左边的「文件」按钮可以把它换成任意旧文件 —— 下一个会话挂上去，第一轮就会收到这行：

  ```
  【对话文件·续接】接着「修插件加载」这条线索（文件 …\threads\2026-10-21-修插件加载.md）：
  <最近 6 条要点的摘要>
  （这条线索共 12 条记忆；要原话用 memory_search 带 thread=3，或直接读这个文件。）
  ```

- **更直白的一步**：挂上旧文件后，你在新会话里说的第一句话会先换来一条**真实的用户消息**
  （`【对话文件·自动续接】…` + 上一个会话最后那条回答），它不是注入、不是注释，就是会话里的一条消息：

  ```
  【对话文件·自动续接】接着「修插件加载」这条线索（文件 …\2026-10-21-修插件加载.md）。
  上一个会话（a147bcec）最后一条回答：

  <那条回答的原文，默认最多 600 字>

  （这条线索累计 12 条记忆 / 2 个会话。直接说下一步要做什么就行。）
  ```

  这条消息由插件通过 `session.append('user/message', …, { surfaceOp: 'append' })` 落进会话日志，
  每个会话只发一次；它自己不会被再采集一遍（否则记忆库会被自己的续接话术污染）。
  不想要这一步就关 `threadAutoSend`，退回上面的隐形注入。
- 挂在旧文件上时，检索会**优先在这条线索内部**取两条再补全库 —— 「接着上次那个问题」靠的是线索内命中，而不是全库泛搜；
- 每条消息同时追加进那个 `.md`（人可读、可备份、可以丢进任何编辑器或 git），库里则记 `thread` 外键。

「突破上下文」在这里的真实边界：续接注入的是一份**摘要**（默认 600 字）而不是整条线索的原文，剩下的靠 `memory_search thread=…` 和 `memory_open` 按需取。窗口没变大，但「同一条线索的连续两次会话」不再从零开始。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。关掉后不采集不召回，已有记忆保留。 |
| `dbPath` | `D:\dsh-memory\vault.db` | 库文件路径。面板「库位置」里改会写 `location.json`（优先于本项）并复制旧库；改写后需重启。 |
| `maxGB` | `5` | 自定义容量（GB）。仅当 `sizePreset = custom` 时生效。 |
| `sizePreset` | `custom` | 常用档位 `1` / `5` / `10` / `20` / `50`（GB），或 `custom` 用 `maxGB`。选档位时忽略 `maxGB`。 |
| `capture` | `true` | 自动沉淀对话。 |
| `captureAssistant` | `true` | 连助手回复一起记。关掉只记你说的。 |
| `captureMinChars` | `8` | 短于此字数的消息不记（「嗯」「好的」不占库）。 |
| `defaultMode` | `long` | 手动 `memory_save` 不传 `mode` 时用哪种：`long` / `multi` / `once`。 |
| `captureMode` | `long` | 自动采集的消息记成哪种。设成 `once` 会让自动采集的记忆被召回一次就删（一般不建议）。 |
| `skipSubagent` | `true` | 跳过子代理会话，避免把中间过程记成记忆。 |
| `recall` | `true` | 每轮自动检索并注入。 |
| `recallLimit` | `5` | 单轮最多注入几条。 |
| `recallMaxChars` | `1200` | 单轮注入的字数上限（占提示词预算）。 |
| `recallSnippetChars` | `160` | 单条摘录的字数上限。召回按「命中词所在那一句」截取，实际常只占一半。 |
| `recallMinQueryChars` | `4` | 输入短于此不检索。 |
| `recallSameSession` | `true` | 是否也取**当前会话**里更早的记忆。关掉则只跨会话召回。 |
| `recallRecentWindow` | `30` | 当前会话最近这么多条不参与召回（它们还在上下文里，重复注入只会挤占预算）。 |
| `sessionIndex` | `true` | 新会话第一轮注入一次「过去会话要点」（压缩层）。关掉则只靠检索按需取。 |
| `sessionIndexLimit` | `6` | 索引最多列几个过去会话（每个约 150 字，只在新会话第一轮付一次）。 |
| `threads` | `true` | 对话文件：每条线索写成磁盘一个 `.md`，会话可以挂到旧文件上接着聊。 |
| `threadResumeTurns` | `6` | 续接旧文件时，第一轮带回多少条最近记忆。 |
| `threadResumeChars` | `600` | 续接摘要的字数上限（只在挂旧文件的第一轮付一次）。 |
| `threadAutoSend` | `true` | 挂上旧文件后，把上一个会话最后那条回答自动发成一条**真实消息**（每个会话一次）。关掉退回隐形注入。 |
| `humanMemory` | `true` | 人类式记忆：三因子排序（相关度 × 显著性 × 时间衰减）+ 联想扩展 + 显著性回填。关掉退回纯 bm25 相关度。 |
| `factCards` | `true` | 巩固层：把跨会话反复出现的重点压成事实卡。召回时事实卡排在最前，并标 `· 事实卡`。 |
| `panel` | `true` | Web 侧边面板（含对话文件列表与库位置）。它会在宿主 Web 载体上新增 HTTP 面 `/memory-vault/*`（stats / search / recent / catalog / entry 只读，resize 是唯一的写路由且只改容量），随监听地址暴露（本机默认回环 127.0.0.1）。 |

配置非法会在**加载期**直接报错并指出是哪个键——不会带着错配置默默跑。

## 它怎么工作

```
对话 ──► session/event ──► 内存队列(1s 批量) ──► SQLite(mem + mem_fts)
                                                      │
下一轮输入 ──► systemPrompt.context(order=130) ──► 新会话第一轮：过去会话要点(压缩层，一次)
                                                └─► 每轮：检索 top-k（带 id）──► 注入当时的上下文
```

- **压缩层**（`sessionDigests`）：每个会话取最近 40 条，按「去重后的关键词数」给句子打分，挑两三句拼成要点。
  纯抽取式、不调模型，所以它抓的是字面重点，不会替你归纳。压缩率大约 1/20~1/50。

几个刻意的设计决定：

- **用 `context` 而不是 `systemPrompt.section`**：context 落在消息流里、每轮随对话变化，改它不会打断系统提示词的前缀缓存。
- **两层检索**：FTS5 trigram 负责 3 字以上的精确子串（`部署脚本`、`FTS5` 这类），查不到时用 2 字词在「最近 2000 条」窗口内补位——中文里最常见的重合恰好是 2 字（`杭州`、`部署`），trigram 结构上做不到，但不能因此漏掉。窗口有界，所以补位不会随 5GB 线性变慢。
- **自己的输出不再入库**：注入的召回块带 `【长期记忆·自动召回】` 标记，采集侧据此跳过。否则模型会把自己召回的内容当成用户的话再说一遍，再被记一遍，滚雪球。
- **去重靠内容指纹**：同样的内容（同角色 + 同正文）全局只存一份，重复出现只累加命中计数。

### 检索是两段式，召回是「按句付钱」

查询进来先拆词（拉丁词原样、中文按 4→3→2 字滑窗，最多 14 个）：

1. **FTS5 trigram**（`MATCH "词1" OR "词2"`，`bm25` 排序）——3 字以上的精确子串，几乎不误报；
2. **2 字词补位**（`LIKE`，只在最近 2000 条窗口内）——兜住「杭州」「部署」这类中文最常见重合，
   按「命中了几个不同的词」重排，所以双词命中会压过单词命中。

召回注入这一侧做了五件事，目标都是「同样的召回质量，更少的字」：

| 手段 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| **按句摘录**（`makeFocusSnippet`） | 只取「命中词所在的那一句」，并一句上下文；长文平均 40~90 字，而不是固定 220 字窗口 |
| **分层预算** | 第 1 条 220 字、第 2 条 160、第 3 条 120，之后 90/80 —— 长尾只是字面擦边，不值得和首条同价 |
| **结果去重**（`dropDuplicates`） | 两条摘录共享一半以上双字词就合并，同一段话不付两次钱 |
| **低信息跳过** | 「好」「继续」「谢谢」这类应答不触发检索——翻旧账的命中率极低，注入了也是噪音 |
| **尾注只说一次** | 「库内共 N 条 / 怎么继续取」每会话说一遍就够；本轮新写入的消息也不会被自己召回 |

实测（38 条真库、5 条真实查询）：旧渲染 6112 字 → 新渲染 3879 字，**省 37%**；单轮从约 900 token 降到约 580 token。
再叠加「长查询少给两条」（查询超过 60 字只取 3 条）和「一轮注入过的 id 不再重复注入」，
连续多轮同主题对话的平均成本还会更低。

### 像人一样记：三个机制，以及它们不像人的地方

| 机制 | 模仿什么 | 实现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **三因子排序** | 遗忘曲线 + 情绪唤醒 | `相关度 × (0.55 + 0.45×显著性) × 0.5^(天数/半衰期)`；半衰期 = `60 + 400×显著性` 天（下限 0.45）。「记住」「必须」「以后都」这类说法会把显著性顶上去，于是更难被忘掉 |
| **联想扩展** | 邻近激活（想起 A 就带出同一场景的 B） | 入库时把同会话相邻 12 条、共享至少 2 个关键词的记忆连成一条边（权重 = 共享词数）；召回时给前两条命中各带一条最强的邻居，标 `· 关联` |
| **巩固层** | 睡眠时把情景压成语义 | 每 10 分钟聚一次：按「共享任意两个关键词」并用查体系聚类，凡横跨 **≥2 个会话**且反复出现的组，抽一句压成事实卡；召回时事实卡排最前，标 `· 事实卡` |
| **单次记忆** | 工作记忆 | `once` 模式注入后立刻删除；`multi` 只在 12 小时内、本会话内可见 |

三条边界必须说清楚：

- **没有向量嵌入**，所以抓不到换说法（「部署脚本」和「发布流程」在它眼里无关）。这是为了避免引入 embedding 依赖；
- 巩固层是**抽取式**的，它只会把反复出现的原句挑出来，不会真的归纳出「用户偏好先给结论」这种抽象结论；
- 显著性靠词表判断，会误判——一段话里出现「记住」就可能被永久抬权。所以 `humanMemory` 可以整体关掉，回到纯相关度排序。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-api-cost

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) plugin bundle that shows **what the current session's API usage costs**, right beside the token counter under the composer — and why.

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

---

## What it is

This repository is a **Harness plugin bundle**: one package that contributes a **Host plugin** and a **Web Client plugin** to a Harness profile.

- The Host plugin registers a session projection (`apiCost`) that folds the provider-reported usage of every settled model call into per-route billing buckets and prices them.
- The Client plugin registers one control in the composer's ambient dock (`conversation.composer.dock`) and renders the value the Host already computed.

It is **not** a skill (skills are model-facing instructions the Agent loads), **not** an agent preset (presets compose plugins for a session), and **not** a standalone app. A bundle is the unit the Harness Plugin Manager installs, enables, and removes.

## What you see

Under the composer, after the built-in statistics:

```
   3 turns 12 steps · 41.2 tok/s     612k tokens · Cache hit 99%     ¥0.83
   └──────────── existing controls ────────────────────────────┘  └ this plugin ┘
```

Clicking the cost opens a small panel:

```
API cost                                              ¥0.83
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash                                   ¥0.83
Input 214k · Cache hit 32.0M · Output 127k
Cache hit rate 99.3%
Peak ¥0 · Off-peak ¥0.83
Estimated from DeepSeek list prices; the invoice is authoritative.
```

The total covers the whole conversation: this Session **plus every subagent session it delegated to**, with their share listed separately. The control reads each descendant's cost itself, so you never have to open that conversation first; while a descendant is unread or still running, the total carries a `+` to mark it as a floor or a provisional figure. Every completed turn also shows its own cost in the turn footer, next to the chat's token-usage entry (`本轮 ¥0.0123`).

The panel also switches to a **time range**: `Today`, `Last 24h`, `Last 7 days`, or `Last 30 days`, totalling every stored session on the machine.

The control disappears while there is no billable usage, and an unrecognized `provider/model` is shown as *No price configured* instead of being silently guessed.

## Install

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or another `0.2.x` release (`engines.dsh` is declared), and the Web UI.

**From the Web UI:** open **Plugins** in the sidebar, choose **Install**, and paste this repository's address:

```
https://github.com/wei2yun/dsh-api-cost
```

**From the CLI:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wei2yun/dsh-api-cost
```

**From an agent:** call `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle` and the same address (or a local checkout path while developing).

A Git install follows the branch head; pin a commit (`github:wei2yun/dsh-api-cost#<sha>`) when you need a reproducible install. The package ships plain ESM, so a Git install runs no build script.

### Distribution

This repository is the bundle itself: no build step, no runtime dependency to install, and every file the Host and the browser load is committed. It installs from a Git dependency, a local checkout, or npm if it is ever published there. Discovery follows the ecosystem's `dsh-plugin` GitHub topic; a plugin-market index entry is optional and not required to install.

Then send a message. A page that was already open before the install has no baseline for the new projection yet, so refresh once if the control does not appear immediately.

The plugin stores nothing and changes no Harness setting beyond its own profile entry. Remove it from the Plugins page at any time.

## Time ranges

The range tabs add up **every session this Harness home has stored, across all workspaces** — the whole machine's consumption under the configured API key, not just the conversation you are reading:

1. The Host reads the durable session store through `ctx.sessionPersistence` — no filesystem parsing, no private paths.
2. Each session is folded into a compact per-call list (time, route, token buckets), skipping a forked session's inherited prefix and keeping the last 35 days.
3. That list is cached against the store's own `revision`, so a repeated query rereads only sessions that changed.
4. Calls are summed exactly inside the half-open window and priced per call with the same book: `Today` starts at local midnight, the others are rolling windows ending now.

The browser reads the result from the plugin's own same-origin route (`/plugins/api-cost/window`), which answers aggregates only — no session ids, no content. The route is part of the Host half, so it exists after the next Harness restart.

## Per-turn cost

Each `assistant/message` also folds into a table keyed by its turn number, so the completed-turn footer can show what that turn cost. The turn chip reads the same projection value the panel does and disappears when the turn has no billable call (a compaction, for example, is billed to the session but belongs to no turn).

## How the number is produced

1. Every settled model call appends an `assistant/message` event carrying the provider's `usage` and the concrete `provider`/`model` route. The summarizer call behind a compaction appends the same facts on `compaction/summary` and is billed like any other call. A streaming attempt is billed from its streamed usage sample and then replaced by the settled message of the same turn and step; `llm/retry-started` closes that replacement slot, so a retried attempt is billed on its own — an aborted call that never settles is still counted once the provider reported usage for it.
2. The projection folds those events into four disjoint buckets per route — uncached input, cache-hit input, cache-write input, output — split by price period.
3. The Client-visible view prices the buckets with the list prices below and publishes the total, the per-route breakdown, and the peak/off-peak split.
4. The control adds the `apiCost` of every descendant session (`origin: subagent`). When the session list does not carry that value yet — a freshly spawned child, or a checkpoint written before this plugin existed — the control asks the session controller to fold the descendant's projections on demand, without opening that conversation. A forked child inherits the parent's log, so its `inherited` share is subtracted and only what the fork itself spent is counted. A child that is still running is read again once it settles, so a mid-run snapshot never becomes the final number.

Because the Session log stays the only source of truth, replay, resume, and fork derive the same number, and the plugin never writes to the log.

## Prices

List prices per **1M tokens**, from the official [DeepSeek pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) (October 2026). Off-peak is half of peak.

| Model | Period | Cache-hit input | Cache-miss input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017) | Peak | ¥0.04 | ¥2 | ¥8 |
| | Off-peak | ¥0.02 | ¥1 | ¥4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) | Peak | ¥0.30 | ¥9 | ¥27 |
| | Off-peak | ¥0.15 | ¥4.50 | ¥13.50 |

USD books for the international platform ship too; switch with `currency: USD`.

- **Billing rules follow DeepSeek's published notes**: peak is Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, excluding statutory holidays (off-peak all day); weekends — including make-up working weekends — are off-peak. Each call is classified by the time its usage was reported. The 2026 statutory holiday calendar is built in; add later years with `offPeakDates`.
- Retired model ids `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are billed at the Flash price.
- DeepSeek bills no separate cache-write fee, so that bucket defaults to 0.
- Only official DeepSeek routes (`deepseek-official`, `deepseek-account`, or another `deepseek…` provider id) inherit these prices. A relay or aggregator that serves the same model id needs an explicit `provider/model` ent

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 可视化管理器：列表 + 详情页，查看工具 schema / 提示 / 资源，支持增删启停与连接测试
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-manager-web **DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 可视化管理器**：在 **设置 → MCP** 里查看、添加、编辑、启停 MCP 服务器，并且能点进单个服务，看到它注册了哪些工具、每个工具的参数结构，以及服务端提供的提示（prompts）和资源（resources）。 > 维护者：[zengshuaishuai](https://github.com/zengshuaishuai) > > 本项目在 MIT 许可的开源项目 dsh-mcp-manager 基础上二次开发：重做了列表与详情界面，并新增工具目录、提示/资源读取等能力。原始版权声明保留在 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 中。 --- ## 界面 **服务器列表**（深色 / 浅色，跟随 DSH 主题）

**服务器详情** —— 连接状态、目标地址、服务版本、补丁文件，以及测试 / 编辑 / 停用 / 删除 ![服务器详情](assets/screenshots/detail-dark.png) **工具目录** —— 搜索工具，展开可看描述与输入参数（必填标记、类型、说明、默认值） ![工具目录与输入参数](assets/screenshots/tools-dark.png) > 截图为示例数据（GitHub MCP 服务器），界面文案与配色随 DSH 的语言 / 主题自动切换。 --- ## 功能 ### 服务器列表 - 紧凑行式列表：状态圆点（已连接 / 告警 / 失败 / 停用）、名称、服务版本、传输方式徽章（流式 / stdio）、工具数、启停开关 - 顶部工具条：刷新、只看已连接、搜索服务器、添加服务器 - 点任意一行进入详情页 ### 详情页 | 标签 | 内容 | |---|---| | **通用** | 连接状态、条目 ID、传输方式、目标地址 / 命令、serverName、工具数、服务版本、超时、补丁文件路径；测试 / 编辑 / 停用 / 删除 | | **工具** | 该服务注册到工具表里的全部工具（`mcp____*`），支持搜索；展开可见描述和**输入参数表**（参数名 / 类型 / 必填 / 说明 / 默认值） | | **提示** | 按需建立一条独立 MCP 连接读取 `prompts/list`；服务端未实现时显示为空 | | **资源** | 同上，读取 `resources/list`（名称 / URI / MIME 类型） | | **日志** | 本页的操作流水（打开详情、探测结果、读取提示/资源的结果），带时间戳 | ### 其他 - **添加 / 编辑 / 删除**：支持 `stdio`（command / args / env / cwd）与 `streamable-http`（url / headers），带 id、serverName、URL 等字段校验 - **连接测试**：独立连接跑一次 `initialize + tools/list`，报告耗时与工具数 - **中英双语**：界面文案跟随 DSH 当前语言 - **深浅主题自适应**：颜色全部取自 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` token，不写死 - **即改即生效**：所有修改写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 harness 的 HMR 热应用（配置层面无需重启） - **MCP 图标**：设置导航里把未知插件默认的齿轮换成了 MCP 插头图标（浏览器端运行时替换） ## 安装 前置：DSH 已经能正常启动（`dsh web` 或 DSH Desktop）。 > 桌面版（Electron）的 profile 名是 `desktop`，Web 版通常是 `web`。下面命令里的 `--profile desktop` 按你的实际情况替换。 ### 方式一：本地源码（`link:`） ```sh git clone https://github.com/zengshuaishuai/dsh-mcp-manager-web.git dsh-mcp-manager-web cd dsh-mcp-manager-web # 仓库已包含构建产物 lib/，只有改过 src/ 才需要重新构建： node scripts/build.mjs dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD" ``` ### 方式二：npm 包 ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add @zengshuaishuai/dsh-mcp-manager-web ``` > pnpm 11 会拒绝「发布不足 24 小时」的新包；若安装时报 `minimum release age`，在 profile 的 > `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude: ["@zengshuaishuai/dsh-mcp-manager-web"]` 后重试。 ### 方式三：直接装 GitHub 源 ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zengshuaishuai/dsh-mcp-manager-web ``` `lib/` 已入库，GitHub 源安装不需要本地构建。 ### 生效 安装后**硬刷新浏览器**（`Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R`），打开 **设置 → MCP**。 如果没看到 MCP 页签，重启一次 DSH（宿主端首次挂载需要）。 ## 配置 插件自身只有一项可选配置 —— 它要编辑哪个补丁文件： ```yaml - id: mcp-manager name: "@zengshuaishuai/dsh-mcp-manager-web" config: patchFile: /Users/you/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml ``` `patchFile` 默认是 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`。**桌面版必须显式指向 `profiles/desktop/`**，否则增删的 MCP 服务器会写进 Web 版 profile、不生效。 ## 架构 ``` src/ ├── index.ts 宿主端入口：注册 /api/mcp-manager 的 Fetch 路由并分发 action ├── status.ts 遍历 loader 里的 mcp-client 条目，投影状态与工具目录 ├── probe.ts 独立 MCP 连接：probe（计数）/ inspect（工具+提示+资源+版本） ├── patch.ts 读写 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（insert / 覆盖 / disabled） ├── validate.ts 表单校验（与 dsh-mcp-client 的 schema 对齐） ├── shared.ts 两端共享的类型与常量 └── client/ 浏览器端：设置页、详情页、文案、样式、图标、RPC 封装 ``` **RPC 端点**（走 harness 自带的 `/api` 通道，复用浏览器鉴权）： | action | 说明 | |---|---| | `list` | 所有 mcp-client 条目 + 状态 + 工具目录 | | `add` / `update` / `remove` | 增改删补丁行 | | `setEnabled` | 启停（写 `disabled` 标记） | | `probe` | 连通性探测（工具数、版本） | | `inspect` | 读取工具（含 schema）、提示、资源、服务版本 | | `patchInfo` | 当前补丁文件路径与是否存在 | 浏览器端通过 `settings.section` 槽位注册页面（order 18），宿主端不依赖任何 `@deepseek-ai` 运行时包（`js-yaml` 方言与 `isJsExpr` 均内联），因此可以放在任意路径安装。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install # 安装依赖（含 esbuild 等构建工具） node scripts/build.mjs # 或 pnpm build ``` 产物： - `lib/index.js` — 宿主端 ESM bundle（`js-yaml`、`@modelcontextprotocol/*`、`@deepseek-ai/*` 均为 external） - `lib/client.js` — 浏览器端 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle（`react` 为 external，运行时由宿主注入） **类型检查的坑**：`tsconfig.json` 里的 `paths` 指向上游作者的 Windows 绝对路径（`D:/ProgramFiles/...`），直接 `tsc` 会找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*`。需要先改成你本地安装的包路径，或另建一份本地 tsconfig。 修改 `src/` 后必须重新构建；客户端改动硬刷新浏览器即可（宿主会观察 `lib/client.js` 的变更），宿主端改动需要重启 DSH。 `test/fixtures/` 下有一个最小的 stdio MCP 服务器，可用于本地联调。 ## 已知限制 - **不支持按工具启用 / 自动批准**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 会把服务端工具全量注册，插件无法单独开关某个工具，也无法为单个工具设置自动批准，所以工具行是只读展示。 - **提示 / 资源不是实时数据**：它们由 `inspect` 单独建连读取，点开时拉一次，不会持续同步。 - **日志是本页操作流水**，不是 mcp-client 进程日志（插件拿不到宿主插件实例的日志）。 - **服务版本**只有在成功连接（打开详情或点测试）之后才有。 - **只能管理用户补丁层的条目**：由 bundle 定义的 MCP 条目不能删除或停用。 - **启停沿用 loader 的 `disabled` 标记**：部分 DSH 版本上重新启用后可能长时间停在「加载中」，此时重启一次 DSH 可恢复。 ## 兼容性 在 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（macOS arm64）** 上开发与验证；MCP 协议侧兼容 stdio 与 streamable-http。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)。本仓库同样以 MIT 发布；原始项目的版权声明保留在 LICENSE 中。

# dsh-ascii-sharks DeepSeek Harness 的 ASCII 海洋背景：新建会话页上，一片字符画的海。 几群真会躲虎鲸的鱼，几头真会追鱼的虎鲸。明暗主题自适应，整体半透明，离屏即停，鼠标划过会惊散鱼群。 > ## ⚠️ 先读 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) > > 这个项目的引擎移植自 [**stackedlol/ascii-sharks**](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)，而**上游没有 LICENSE 文件**。 > **本仓库没有许可证**（没有 LICENSE 文件，也不是 MIT）。因为移植进来的引擎本身没有授权，给整个仓库挂开源许可证会误导人。 > 自己用、本地跑、读代码没问题；要复用到自己项目、公司部署或商用，请先向[上游作者](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks/issues/1)取得授权。详见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。 > > 授权请求已于 2026-10-21 [在上游 issue #1 留言](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks/issues/1#issuecomment-6312209674)，**目前等回复**。取得授权后这里会换成正式 LICENSE；被拒绝则重写受影响的五个文件。

引擎移植自 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)，**重写为一个 DSH 客户端插件**：宿主生命周期、明暗主题、整体透明度、虎鲸外形都是新加的。授权见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。 ![新建会话页上的 ASCII 海洋](docs/hero-dark.png) ![设置里的「ASCII 海洋」页](docs/settings.png) ## 它做了什么 - **只在新建会话页出现。** 有会话在屏幕上时，背景里动的东西就是阅读成本，所以海洋随 hero 相位挂载、随会话激活卸载。 - **真的人工生命，不是循环动画。** 鱼是 boids（分离/对齐/聚合）+ Couzin 分区，每条鱼背后有 127° 盲区；恐慌沿鱼群逐跳传递，所以整群会突然炸开，即便只有边缘几条真的看见了鲨鱼。鲨鱼是 20 节点脊髓 + follow-the-leader，转弯半径随速度变大，饥饿度累积、吃到鱼才下降，且偏好抓落单的鱼。 - **随机换种，每只各自抽。** 「整群种类」里点「随机」，每头鲸鱼独立抽自己的种类，每次回到新建会话页重新抽过。重复是允许的 —— 九种里抽三只，撞上同一只是常态；去重会把「随机」悄悄变成「不放回抽样」，那是另一回事。抽取发生在挂载那一刻，所以同一屏里不会边游边变身；存储里记的是「开了随机」，不是抽到的结果。 - **不做纯白高光。** 侧身有一道缓慢的"反光"沿身体扫过。它曾经用纯 `#ffffff`，结果 3.7 秒的周期里有约一秒把最多 50% 的躯干刷成白色字形 —— 肉眼看到的就是"鲸鱼一秒变白"。现在改成灰蓝提亮（`#4a5262`）、波峰用六次方收窄、阈值 0.985：平均覆盖 2.8%，峰值 20%。 - **眼斑按「能认出来」定大小，不按野外比例。** 查过 NOAA 的[虎鲸解剖](https://oceantoday.noaa.gov/killerwhaleanatomy/welcome.html)：虎鲸是反荫蔽色，俯视时背部本来就是黑的。我照着改成「俯视全黑 + 侧缘一条腹色接缝」，结果是技术上说得通、观感上全废 —— 在 40 格的分辨率下，眼斑是唯一能让人认出「这是虎鲸」的特征，抹掉它就只剩一团带背鳍的黑影。现在的做法是：形态保真（分叉尾叶、圆桨胸鳍、高背鳍、眼斑），比例服从格子能承载的信息量。背鳍后那块鞍斑用**灰色**（NOAA 称之为 "grey swoosh"），这一条照实做。 - **九种，零素材。** 外形是数学函数（半宽剖面 + 鳍根位置），现场光栅化成字符格。默认 `orca`，另有 `classic / hammerhead / greathammer / tiger / zebra / mako / thresher / nurse`。 - **分叉尾叶是单独做的几何。** `halfWidth` 从脊柱量起，只能描述左右对称的形状，任何「尾巴」都会被画成一根横杠。所以尾叶是 `shapes.ts` 里的 `flukes` 三个数字（偏移、半宽、后伸），在渲染器里按**尾部自己的坐标系**判定两个椭圆叶瓣；中间留空的那块就是分叉。 - **尾部按鲸类的方式动，不是鱼的方式。** 这是让尾巴「不僵硬」的关键：鱼类左右甩尾，鲸类上下拍尾 —— 俯视看，鱼的尾巴横向扫，鲸的尾巴沿体轴前后伸缩、同时叶瓣开合。第一版给尾叶加了横向甩动，那是鱼的动作装在海豚身上，所以怎么看怎么别扭。现在 `tailBeat`（前后行程 ±0.045L）与 `tailSpan`（开合 0.81–1.19）同由一个 `sh.phase` 驱动、相差四分之一周期，与身体的行波锁相。 - **圆桨胸鳍同理。** 三角形鳍只能画出细长条或长条，`paddle` 用「前缘 + 弦长」按跨距参数化，才能画出圆头的桨叶。实测外露约 5 格，一眼能看见。 - **整体半透明。** 默认 0.6，设置里可调 0.1–1。透明度作用在 canvas 上而不是逐个颜色上，所以网格、尾迹、鱼和虎鲸是同一个系数一起淡下去的，虎鲸才像在水里，而不是浮在水前面。 - **跟着 shell 的明暗走。** 暗色下是亮块挖暗字，亮色下是淡灰底压深字。切主题时海洋当场换色，不用刷新。 - **不开着不干活的循环。** 离屏停、切标签页停、`prefers-reduced-motion` 下只画一帧、DPR 封顶 2、固定 1/60 步长最多补 4 帧。 ## 装 ```sh sh scripts/install.sh # 默认接进 desktop profile sh scripts/install.sh --profile=web ``` 然后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（宿主启动时才扫描插件清单）。 装完： - 新建会话页的背景就是这片海； - `设置` 左侧导航里多一个 **「ASCII 海洋」** 页：顶部是运行状态（正在运行 / 已暂停 / 已关闭 / 系统要求减弱动效），下面依次是透明度、浓淡、**数量（1–5）**、整群种类（含**随机**）、鼠标驱鱼。 - `设置 → 通用设置` 里也有一行快捷开关（透明度、浓淡、物种、鼠标驱鱼）。 > **为什么侧栏「插件」页里看不到它？** 那一页只列 DSH 自己的官方 bundle（`@deepseek-ai/*` 的固定名单），第三方客户端插件不在其中 —— `dsh-visualize`、`dsh-computer-use` 同样不在。`设置 → 内置插件` 那份只读清单列的是各 Agent 预设内部挂的插件，顶层挂载的第三方包也不在里面。所以「设置 → ASCII 海洋」这一页就是它在 DSH 里唯一能被按名字找到的地方，这一页正是为此加的。 默认是 **3 头虎鲸**在不同深度巡游，整体透明度 0.72。数量可在 1–5 之间调。 游速比原版慢：鲸鱼巡航降到 0.58 倍（约 2.4 格/秒），冲刺倍率也从 1.45 收到 1.25；鱼群 0.82 倍 —— 鱼小，同样的像素速度看起来慢得多，减太多会显得停住。 摘除： ```sh sh scripts/install.sh --uninstall ``` 偏好存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-ascii-sharks:v1`），不写进 Host 的设置文档——这是每窗口的视觉口味，不该跨机器同步。 ## 开发 ```sh npm install npm run verify # 类型检查 + 构建 Host 半区 + 构建浏览器半区 npm run preview # 生成 preview/harness.js open preview/index.html # 带 sidebar/hero/composer 的模拟页 open preview/lab.html # 外形实验室：八种鲨鱼并排，静止 open preview/parity.html # 与上游原版同条件（整屏、四条 classic） ``` `preview/` 是开发用的，不进发布包。 ### 结构 ``` src/ index.ts Host 半区：只发布默认值，其余留空（见下） entry.ts 浏览器半区入口：注册两个座位，没有渲染逻辑 surface.tsx 海洋座位：把 canvas 挂进会话列 settings-row.tsx 设置行（总开关 / 透明度 / 浓淡 / 物种 / 鼠标驱鱼） store.ts 共享配置 store（localStorage 后备） engine.ts 固定步长循环、resize、指针、透明度、离屏暂停 world.ts 鱼群与虎鲸/鲨鱼的行为模拟 renderer.ts 逐格字符光栅化 shapes.ts 九种外形函数（八种鲨鱼 + 虎鲸） species.ts 五种鱼的行为参数表 math.ts clamp / 角度差 / 哈希噪声 / 无散度海流 ``` ### 三个必须知道的约束 1. **浏览器半区必须是一个自包含的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load()` 调用。** loader 给的 `require` 只认 shell 已经种进平台表的模块（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`），解析不了本地路径。所以 `scripts/build-client.mjs` 用 esbuild 把引擎打成一个 CommonJS bundle 再套上 loader 信封。React 必须留在 external——打进第二份 React 会让组件拿到另一个 hook dispatcher，每个 hook 都炸。 2. **canvas 挂在会话列里，不挂 `shell.overlay`。** overlay 是 `z-index: 20` 的整框浮层、在每一列之上；把背景画在那儿会盖住内容。挂进列里、给 canvas `z-index: -1` 配 `isolation: isolate`，才是「列底色之上、所有内容之下」——层级是诚实的，不用跟浮层打架。 3. **文案字典要在 `ctx.inject(["locale"], …)` 里注册。** 冷启动时这个 bundle 比 locale 插件先激活，`ctx.get("locale")` 会答 undefined；一次性 `ctx.effect` 在那儿放弃，整个页面生命周期内 namespace 都不会注册，症状是每个标签都渲染成自己的 key。 ## 来源 引擎逻辑、行为参数与外形比例移植自 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)（TypeScript，零依赖）。 上游仓库**当时没有 LICENSE 文件**，issue #1「Missing license」还开着。所以本仓库也**不提供许可证** —— 移植进来的部分我没有权利授权给你，原创部分我也选择不授权。想合法复用，先找上游作者。 改动清单： - 去掉上游的黑底与固定网格画布，改成透明背景 + 自适应主题； - 上游把鲨鱼活动区绕开居中的标题椭圆，这里改成绕开由宿主测量的 hero 区域（侧栏展开时内容列不是居中的）； - 新增虎鲸外形与白眼斑/鞍斑（`FLAG_PALE`），并新增整体透明度（作用在 canvas 合成层上）； - 上游 `base.css` 之外还画了一圈环境点阵，这里去掉——在 DSH 里它和宿主的字符网格打架； - 指针输入、离屏暂停、可见性暂停、`prefers-reduced-motion` 全部接到宿主生命周期上； - 新增配置 store、设置行、locale 字典。

plugins.description: A community-maintained Toollery integration for DeepSeek Harness, enabling scalable, training-free skill and tool retrieval.
plugins.readme_text:
# Toollery for DeepSeek Harness

An independent implementation of [Toollery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22218) for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Generate three proxy queries per tool, cache them locally, and retrieve a smaller tool set for each user turn.

This project implements an existing method, not an original algorithm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Toollery authors or the DSH team. Original repository: [XiangxiTian/toollery](https://github.com/XiangxiTian/toollery). The manual-generation prompt follows Appendix A.1; see [Acknowledgements](ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md).

## What it does

- Discovers the complete tool pool visible to a DSH agent after configured sources finish loading.
- Validates cached manuals and generates missing or changed entries when explicitly requested.
- Searches `spec`, `manual`, or `spec_manual` with local BM25.
- Sends selected tools' **original schemas** to the chat model. Manuals stay in the local search index.
- Provides an ON/OFF switch, retrieval settings and per-turn selected/called tool cards in the official DSH Web UI.
- Supports the bundled 12-tool demo, a filesystem MCP preset, and configured MCP or Cordis sources.

The default is **ON / spec_manual / top_k / k=3**. OFF gives DSH the full original tool pool and bypasses retrieval. `all` retains every tool but can still rank them using the selected representation.

## Install and try it

### Windows: free preview, no API key

**Requires Windows x64, a writable folder and internet access.** Python, Node.js, pnpm and DSH are installed privately; no administrator rights or preinstalled development tools are needed.

**[Download the latest release](https://github.com/JKL-agents/toollery-dsh/releases/latest)** and select **Source code (zip)**. Extract it to use the double-click launcher. This link always opens the latest published release.

For fixes not yet included in a release, download the [development ZIP from main](https://github.com/JKL-agents/toollery-dsh/archive/refs/heads/main.zip). It may contain unreleased changes.

1. Extract the ZIP, open the extracted repository folder, and double-click **`Start-Toollery.cmd`**. Run it from the extracted folder, not inside the ZIP.
2. Keep the terminal open while dependencies install. First use may take several minutes; the browser setup page opens when installation finishes. If it does not open, copy the full **`Toollery setup:`** URL printed in the terminal into your browser.
3. Select **12 utility tools**, check **Scripted preview — no API key or charges**, and leave retrieval at **ON / Spec + manual / top-k / k=3**. No API credentials are required.
4. Select **Start demo** and wait for the DSH page to open. If the new tab is blocked, select **Open DSH demo** on the setup page. Accept DSH's first-run notice if shown; use the workspace picker if the workspace does not open automatically.
5. Send this prompt:

   ```text
   Use add_numbers to add 19 and 23.
   ```

You should see `add_numbers` called and the result **42**. Change k or switch Toollery OFF, then repeat the prompt to compare selected tools. Another supported prompt is `Use celsius_to_fahrenheit to convert 20 Celsius.`

This free preview executes real DSH tools with a scripted model and mock manuals. It supports the example requests, not arbitrary chat, and makes no paid API requests.

The launcher creates a **standalone demo with its own DSH environment**. It is not yet a bundle installable through an existing DSH's Plugins page. See [integration](docs/integration.md) for the current opt-in wrapper approach to an existing host.

### Use your own chat and manual-generation models

1. On the setup page, stop any running demo and uncheck **Scripted preview**. Start with **12 utility tools**; the filesystem and custom pools are described in the [launcher guide](docs/launcher.md).
2. Enter your chat model, API base URL and key. Chat requires a DSH-compatible DeepSeek Messages API. The defaults are `deepseek-flash` and `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`.
3. Manual generation uses an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible API, defaulting to `deepseek-flash` and `https://api.deepseek.com`. Expand **Separate manual-generation model or key** to use a different provider, model or key. Initially, the chat key is reused unless you supply a separate manual key.
4. For first real use with Toollery ON, check **Allow API calls to generate missing or stale manuals**, then select **Start demo**. Preparation finishes before the DSH chat opens.

**There are two separate sources of API usage:** generating missing or stale manuals during preparation, and calling the chat model during conversations. Valid cached manuals are reused on later starts. Scripted-preview manuals are isolated and do not replace real manuals. OFF bypasses manual preparation; turning ON later requires a valid cache or generation permission.

Credentials are saved locally in `.toollery-launcher/workspace/.env`. Blank key fields retain previously saved keys. For separate credentials, removal of saved keys and custom configurations, see the [launcher guide](docs/launcher.md#real-models-and-manual-generation).

### Stop, restart and troubleshoot

- **Stop:** select **Stop demo** on the setup page; press Ctrl+C in the terminal to close the launcher too. Closing a browser tab alone does not stop the processes.
- **Next time:** double-click the same **`Start-Toollery.cmd`** again. Dependencies, settings and valid manuals are reused. Each demo start creates a fresh DSH session; chat history is not resumed.
- **Ports:** DSH defaults to **3080** and uses a free localhost port if busy. Use the opened or displayed authenticated URL; the setup page has a separate port.
- **Installation failed:** check the terminal message and retry. First use needs access to GitHub, nodejs.org, PyPI and the npm registry. See [launcher troubleshooting](docs/launcher.md#script-options-and-troubleshooting) for blocked scripts and download failures.

### DSH Web UI demos

**Change k and try a different prompt.** Start with an addition request at k=3, then change k to 5 and ask for a temperature conversion. Each turn shows the retrieved candidates and actual tool calls.

![DSH integration: change k from 3 to 5 and retrieve tools for different prompts](DSH_Toollery_demo.gif)

**Switch OFF during a conversation.** Disable Toollery and repeat the request. The next turn bypasses retrieval and makes all 12 tools available. The k setting is retained but has no effect while Toollery is OFF.

![DSH integration: switch Toollery OFF and restore all 12 tools for the next turn](DSH_Toollery_demo_2.gif)

Both recordings use the bundled 12-tool demo. Settings apply to the next turn; they do not change a turn already in progress.

## Manual installation

### Prerequisites

The Windows double-click launcher above installs its own dependencies. For manual installation, prepare:

- Python 3.12 or later; Python 3.12.7 was tested on Windows.
- Node.js 22.19+ on the 22.x line, or 24+, for Web and the filesystem preset. Node 23 is unsupported. pnpm 11.x is required to install the pinned Web/MCP runtime, but not to run it afterward. Node 24.19 / pnpm 11.25 were tested.
- For real model use, a chat API compatible with DSH's configured DeepSeek Messages provider, and an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible API for manuals. Defaults use `deepseek-flash` for both; these settings are independent.

DSH is pinned to Python `0.2.1rc2` / npm `0.2.1-rc.2`. Windows is verified; Linux and macOS are not yet verified. Distribution is through GitHub, not npm or PyPI.

Install [Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/), [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download) and [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation) as needed. After installation, reopen PowerShell and check `node --version` and `pnpm --version` **in the terminal you will use to launch Web**. An IDE or coding agent may have its own tools on PATH; that does not make them available in a normal terminal. The bundled terminal demo uses the Python SDK runtime and does not require a separate Node/pnpm installation. Configured MCP servers may require additional execu

plugins.readme_text:
English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

# Cyrus Plugins · @cyrus/dsh-plugins

A plugin collection for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install this one bundle to get every plugin listed below; each plugin can also be installed on its own.

![The Context Lens panel](plugins/context-insight/docs/images/01-merged-tree.png)

## Plugins

| Plugin                                                 | npm package                  | What it does                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Context Lens](./plugins/context-insight/README.en.md) | `@cyrus/dsh-context-insight` | Opens up what each turn of a Claude Code, DSH or Codex session actually fed the model: composition, tool calls, compactions, cost. Read-only. |

## Install

Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer (see `docs/adr/0002-asar-021-is-the-contract.md`). First decide which profile to install into: the desktop app uses `desktop`, `dsh web` on the command line uses `web`. Installing into the wrong profile does not error; the plugin just never shows up.

**Install the collection (recommended)** to get every plugin at once; when a plugin is added to the collection later, upgrading the collection brings it in.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cyrus/dsh-plugins
```

**Install a single plugin**:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cyrus/dsh-context-insight
```

Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH. "Cyrus Plugins" or "Context Lens" in the plugin manager means it worked.

> **Pick one of the two.** The collection and the standalone plugin insert the same id into the loader tree; with both in `dsh.profile.bundles`, DSH fails at boot with `duplicate loader entry id`. Run `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove` on one before switching to the other.
>
> Do not install from the git URL (`pnpm add https://github.com/...`): the root depends on `workspace:^`, which is only rewritten to a version number when publishing to npm.

Each plugin's usage, permission boundary and known limitations live in its own README.

## Repository layout

This is a pnpm monorepo. Only the collection and `plugins/*` are published; the rest is inlined into the plugins at build time.

| Path                         | Contents                                                                  | Published                             |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `/` (root)                   | The collection bundle: `cordis.patch.yml` + `locale/`                     | **yes**, `@cyrus/dsh-plugins`         |
| `plugins/context-insight`    | The Context Lens plugin: host half and browser half                       | **yes**, `@cyrus/dsh-context-insight` |
| `packages/session-contract`  | The unified IR, wire types and their guards                               | no                                    |
| `packages/session-readers`   | Claude Code / Codex / DSH readers                                         | no                                    |
| `packages/plugin-kit`        | Plugin-agnostic JSON envelope and URL spelling                            | no                                    |
| `packages/plugin-kit-host`   | Host-half plumbing: route table, same-origin gate, envelope, LRU          | no                                    |
| `packages/plugin-kit-client` | Browser-half plumbing: decoding fetch, style injection, slot registration | no                                    |
| `apps/preview`               | Local preview harness on `:5178`                                          | no                                    |
| `scripts`                    | CSS build, bundle-contract check, install script, session probes          | no                                    |
| `tooling`                    | Package alias table, tsconfig base, tsdown config                         | no                                    |

Dependencies point one way only: `plugins/* → packages/*`. The package-name-to-source mapping lives in `tooling/aliases.ts`, and `tsconfig.json`'s `paths` mirrors it, so tests, the preview app and the build never need the internal packages built first.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
```

```bash
pnpm dev
```

The preview runs at <http://localhost:5178> and reads your real local sessions; add `?theme=light` or `?theme=dark` to switch themes.

Run the gates before you commit:

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && npx vitest run && npx tsdown && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs plugins/context-insight
```

Install the working tree into your local DSH to try it (packs, installs, and checks that the installed copy really is the new build):

```bash
pnpm install:plugin
```

Regenerate the README screenshots from the preview (headless Chrome, 1440×900; add `-- --theme light` for the light theme). They show the sessions on your machine, so look at them before committing:

```bash
pnpm screenshots
```

## Publishing

Follow [`docs/RELEASE.md`](./docs/RELEASE.md): the plugin first, then the collection.

## Documentation

- [`docs/RELEASE.md`](./docs/RELEASE.md) — publishing to npm
- `docs/PLAN.md` — decisions and milestones (Chinese)
- `docs/IR.md` — the unified turn IR, the adapter contract (Chinese)
- `docs/API.md` — host route contract (Chinese)
- `docs/HANDOFF.md` — handoff contract (Chinese)
- `docs/adr/` — architecture decision records (Chinese)
- `GLOSSARY.md` — vocabulary (Chinese)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that supervises the local WorkBuddy reverse-proxy chain (wb2api gateway + Responses API bridge), so the provider port is always answering
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workbuddy-codex

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps the local WorkBuddy reverse-proxy chain alive — the model picker's provider, the gateway behind it, **and the Responses bridge that OpenAI Codex CLI needs**.

Three things have to line up before a WorkBuddy model can answer, and none of them installs itself as a Windows service:

| Port | Service | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `127.0.0.1:7863` | `wb2api` gateway | OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` |
| `127.0.0.1:7864` | Responses bridge (**bundled**) | Responses API → chat/completions, for Codex CLI |
| — | `workbuddy` provider | the model-picker route, **mounted from [`dsh-llm-workbuddy`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-llm-workbuddy)** |

Both processes used to be started by hand, so a reboot silently left the model picker pointing at a dead port — the provider plugin loaded fine, listed models fine, and failed on the first request. This plugin supervises them: on load it probes each health endpoint, spawns whatever is missing, and re-checks on a timer so a crashed process comes back.

It deliberately **does not reimplement the gateway, and does not fork the adapter either**. The gateway is orchestrated as a process. The provider route is mounted by delegating to `dsh-llm-workbuddy` with `ctx.plugin()` — that package owns the ~2.5k-line WorkBuddy adapter, its settings section and its daily checkin scheduler, and a second copy of all that would drift the moment either side is updated. So one install covers provider + gateway + bridge.

The delegation is additive, not exclusive: if you also keep `dsh-llm-workbuddy` enabled standalone, whichever plugin registers the route first keeps it and the other stands down with a log line, so both layouts are safe.

## Settings

Everything lives under the `workbuddy-codex` entry's `config` in the profile's `cordis.yml`; the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` has the full default set.

| Key | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gatewayDir` | `~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/workbuddy2api-panel` | Where the gateway keeps `config.json`. The `api_key` in it is used for **both** the bridge and the provider, so the port and the key are configured once. |
| `provider.enabled` | `true` | Register the `workbuddy` route. |
| `provider.baseURL` | *(empty → `gateway.baseURL`)* | Gateway URL for the adapter. |
| `provider.discovery` | `true` | Ask the gateway's `/v1/models` for the live catalog. |
| `provider.autoCheckin` | `true` | Claim the daily WorkBuddy checkin. |
| `gateway.acceptStatus` | `[200, 503]` | The gateway answers `503` while running without a usable account — alive, not down. |
| `bridge.conversationId` | `auto` | Not optional against a WorkBuddy gateway: without it the upstream answers `400 / 11-128` and the gateway disables the account. |
| `bridge.maxPromptTokens` | `1200000` | Above this estimated prompt size the bridge answers `413` locally instead of forwarding a body the upstream rejects with `400 prompt_too_long`. `0` turns it off. See [Why a local prompt ceiling](#why-a-local-prompt-ceiling). |

If `dsh-llm-workbuddy` is not installed at all, the plugin still supervises the gateway and the bridge and logs the one command that fixes it (`dsh plugin add dsh-llm-workbuddy`). Nothing throws.

## Why the bridge is bundled

`codex-cli` 0.1xx+ dropped `wire_api = "chat"` and speaks **only** the OpenAI Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`, SSE). A WorkBuddy gateway implements **only** Chat Completions (`POST /v1/chat/completions`). Point Codex straight at the gateway and every request dies with:

```
unexpected status 404 Not Found, url: http://127.0.0.1:7863/v1/responses
```

There is no config flag around this — Codex rejects `wire_api = "chat"` at load time. A translation layer is mandatory, so this package ships one:

```
Codex CLI --(Responses)--> bridge :7864 --(ChatCompletions)--> gateway :7863 --> WorkBuddy
```

It is the same code as [codex-chat-bridge](https://github.com/kangjiazhen/codex-chat-bridge), vendored at `bridge/codex-chat-bridge.mjs` (zero dependencies, runs on the harness's own Node) so installing this plugin is the only step — there is no second repo to clone and no path to fill in.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/kangjiazhen/dsh-workbuddy-codex.git
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-workbuddy-codex
```

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the profile picks up the `workbuddy-codex` entry automatically once the package is a profile dependency.

### Coming from dsh-llm-workbuddy

This package now covers what that one did, so a profile that already had it enabled needs one edit: drop it from `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json` and leave it in `dependencies`.

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  // "dsh-llm-workbuddy",   <- remove this line
  "dsh-workbuddy-codex"
] } }
```

The package itself has to stay installed — this plugin imports it to mount the provider, and there is no second copy of the adapter to drift. Leaving both in `bundles` is not harmful either: the first one to register keeps the route and the other logs `already-served`, but then this plugin is not the thing serving your models, which defeats the point.

### If the git install fails

`pnpm` rewrites `git+https://…` to `git+ssh://git@…` unless told otherwise, so an install on a machine without GitHub SSH keys fails with `Permission denied (publickey)`:

```bash
npm config set git-protocol https
```

Behind a proxy, git also needs to be told about it, because `pnpm` shells out to the `git` binary and does not forward its own proxy settings:

```bash
git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
```

## Using it with Codex

The bridge listens on `7864` and presents a Responses API. Point Codex at it:

```toml
# ~/.codex/config.toml
model = "global:gpt-5.3-codex"
model_provider = "wb"

[model_providers.wb]
name = "workbuddy"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:7864/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
experimental_bearer_token = "anything"
request_max_retries = 2
stream_max_retries = 2
```

The bearer is not checked by the bridge — it authenticates to the gateway itself with the key it reads from the gateway's `config.json`. Set it to any non-empty string; Codex refuses to start without one.

Then just use Codex normally:

```bash
codex exec "list the files in this directory"
```

If you pick a model your account tier cannot use, the gateway answers `11158 model not allowed for user type [...]`. That is an account property, not a bridge fault — see [Model availability](#model-availability).

### Two settings you must not skip

**1. `conversation_id` — the one that can disable your account.**

The WorkBuddy upstream validates three headers (`X-Conversation-ID`, `X-Conversation-Request-ID`, `X-Conversation-Message-ID`) and answers `400 {"code":"11-128","msg":"request illegal"}` when they are missing. The gateway classifies that as an *account fault* and responds by **disabling the account** — every account it touched, in the same pass. The resulting message says `re-login required`, which is misleading: the credentials are usually still valid and reviving them restores service immediately.

So the bridge defaults to `conversationId: auto`: it derives a stable id per Codex session (from `prompt_cache_key`) and sends it as `metadata.conversation_id`. Do not blank this out. The plugin warns at startup if you do.

If you have already tripped it, revive the accounts rather than re-logging in:

```bash
# gateway panel: http://127.0.0.1:7863/panel/
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7863/panel/api/accounts/<uid>/revive
```

**2. The bearer must match the gateway's `api_key`.**

The gateway answers `401` to every request without it. Rather than making you copy the secret, the plugin reads `api_key` straight out of the gateway's `config.json` (that is what `gatewayDir` is for) and hands it to the bridge. Set `bridge.apiKey` only to override that.

### Images only arrive if the model catalog says so

Codex reads `~/.codex/models.json` *before* it builds a request. If the selected model's entry does not list `image`

plugins.description: On-demand consultation with the OpenAI Codex CLI from DeepSeek Harness: read-only reviews, inline evidence, verified model provenance, quota guardrails and durable call logs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-consult

> Bring **OpenAI Codex CLI** into **DeepSeek Harness** as an on-demand consultant.

`dsh-codex-consult` gives every DSH agent three tools:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_consult` | Ask Codex to plan, review or diagnose something — with evidence inlined, the **served** model/effort verified, quota snapshotted before *and* after, and a durable call log. |
| `codex_quota` | Read the latest Codex quota snapshot (5-hour window + weekly window) **without any API call**. |
| `codex_calls` | Inspect recent consultant calls: status, model, duration, verification, label. |

The goal is a **low-friction, auditable second opinion**: DSH agents can consult a
different family of models for architecture decisions, review of user-facing
reports, hard debugging and acceptance verdicts — and the transcript proves
which model actually answered.

---

## Why this exists

A single model family can be confidently wrong. Consulting an independent model
is cheap insurance — but naive integrations fail in three ways that this plugin
fixes:

1. **The request lies about the model.** A CLI may silently downgrade (capacity,
   quotas, provider fallbacks). This plugin reads the Codex **rollout file** and
   verifies the served model and reasoning effort; a mismatch fails the call.
2. **Long reviews die mid-stream.** Behind proxies, long streaming responses
   get reset. With `transport: "https"` the plugin raises stream-idle budgets and
   retries in the same thread (`codex exec resume`), re-sending the full prompt so
   the answer is never a stitched fragment.
3. **Nobody knows how much it costs.** Every call snapshots Codex quota from the
   CLI's own telemetry before and after, logs to a durable index, and can refuse
   or warn above configurable thresholds.

---

## Requirements

- **DeepSeek Harness** with the `tools` capability (tested against `0.2.0-rc.*`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools >= 0.1.5-rc.2`).
- **Codex CLI** installed and logged in (`codex --version` works, `codex login`
  done). The plugin auto-detects the newest install and never reads
  `auth.json`.
- Node.js 22+ (DSH ships its own runtime; nothing extra is needed).

---

## Install

### A. Into one DSH profile (local package)

```powershell
# 1. place the package where the profile can resolve it
$profile = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$profile\node_modules\dsh-codex-consult" -Target "D:\path\to\dsh-codex-consult"

# 2. mount it — append to the profile patch file
#    %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: codex-consult
      name: dsh-codex-consult
```

Restart DSH (or reload the profile). The three tools appear in every session of
that profile.

> A package mounted through a bundle does not need the `insert` block above —
> bundles already carry `cordis.patch.yml` (see
> [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)). The manual `insert` is for people
> who mount the package directly from a profile's `node_modules`.

### B. As a bundle (recommended for distribution)

Add the package to the profile `package.json` and to the bundle list:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-codex-consult": "^0.1.0" },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-codex-consult"]
    }
  }
}
```

### C. From npm (once published)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-codex-consult
```

---

## Configure

All options live under the plugin node (`codex-consult`), e.g. in the profile
patch file:

```yaml
- id: codex-consult
  config:
    codexPath: ""                                    # empty = auto-detect
    codexHome: ""                                    # empty = ~/.codex
    stateDir: ""                                     # empty = $DSH_HOME/codex-calls
    model: gpt-6-astra
    effort: high
    transport: https                                 # recommended behind proxies
    sandbox: read-only
    timeoutSec: 900
    maxAttempts: 3
    loadUserConfig: false
    requireModelVerification: true
    proxyUrl: http://127.0.0.1:7897
    keepCalls: 100
    quota:
      enabled: true
      warnOnly: true
      primaryMaxPercent: 90
      weeklyMaxPercent: 85
```

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` / `effort` | `gpt-6-astra` / `high` | Per-call overrides are available on the tool. |
| `transport` | `native` | `https` adds a stable long-stream provider (`dsh-https`) for proxy users. |
| `sandbox` | `read-only` | Codex does not need write access: evidence is inlined. |
| `requireModelVerification` | `true` | Set `false` only when Codex does not write rollout logs. |
| `proxyUrl` | `""` | Child-process proxy; empty = inherit environment. |
| `quota.warnOnly` | `true` | `false` makes the guard *refuse* expensive calls. |

---

## Usage

Any DSH agent can call the tools directly. Typical prompts:

```text
Review papers/phystwin/docs/06-report.md and the evidence in
research/.../render_metrics_20261021.txt. Are the conclusions supported?

Use codex_consult with evidenceFiles to review my final answer before I send it.
```

```text
codex_quota          # before an expensive review
codex_calls {limit:5} # what did we already ask?
```

`codex_consult` returns, besides the full answer:

- `model` / `effort` — requested; `modelVerified` — proven from the rollout;
- `elapsedSec`, `finalChars`, token `usage`;
- `quotaBefore` / `quotaAfter` (e.g. `5h 3% · weekly 22%`);
- `callDir` / `resultFile` — the durable record of this call.

---

## How verification works

After Codex finishes, the plugin locates the rollout file for the exact thread
(`~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*<thread>.jsonl`), reads the last
`turn_context` event and compares its `model` and `effort` with the request. The
call is only `ok` when they match (unless verification is disabled). Evidence
comes from the CLI's own metadata — the plugin never opens `auth.json`.

## How quota snapshots work

Codex records `rate_limits` in `token_count` events. The plugin tails recent
rollouts (no network call), so `codex_quota` is free and instant. Before each
call the guard can *refuse* (or warn) when the short/ weekly window is over
budget; after each call it records the delta.

---

## Security

- `read-only` Codex sandbox by default; `approval_policy="never"` is passed for
  non-interactive runs, so a consultant call can never sit waiting for approval.
- Evidence is inlined into the prompt. **Prompt and answer files are stored under
  the call directory** and may contain sensitive project data — treat them like
  the documents you attached.
- The plugin only spawns the Codex executable the user configured or installed.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_not_found` | Set `codexPath` or `CODEX_CLI_PATH`. |
| `proxy_unavailable` | Start the proxy, fix `proxyUrl`, or unset it. |
| `effective_model_or_effort_unverified` | Codex downgraded/rewrote the model; check quotas, or disable verification if rollout logs are unavailable. |
| `usage_limit` / `capacity` | Wait for the window, downgrade `model`/`effort`, or rely on `codex_quota`. |
| Long calls die (~2 min) | Use `transport: https`; the HTTPS provider raises stream idle timeouts. |
| `codex_config` errors | `loadUserConfig: false` keeps calls hermetic; turn it on only if you need user MCP servers/profiles. |

## Development

```powershell
node test/unit.mjs    # pure helpers, no network
node test/e2e.mjs     # fake DSH ctx + one real Codex call (needs auth + network)
```

Layout:

```
lib/core.mjs     path resolution, rollout provenance, quota, prompt assembly, call index
lib/runner.mjs   Codex CLI invocation engine (retries, resume, telemetry)
lib/index.mjs    DSH plugin entry: config schema + three tools
test/            unit + e2e
examples/        AGENTS.md snippet, profile patch sample
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) for version history.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Run the Windows DSH shell tool in Git Bash (MinGW64) instead of PowerShell.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-win-mingw

把 Windows 上 DSH 的默认 shell 工具从 PowerShell 换成 **Git Bash**。

仓库：<https://github.com/Scorpiour/dsh-mingw>

Git for Windows 本身就自带一套 MinGW64 用户态（`bash`、coreutils、`git`、编译器工具链都在其中），
所以这里**不需要单独安装 MinGW 或 MSYS2**：插件直接用 Git 自带的
`C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe`，并把它所在的目录放到子进程 `PATH` 最前面。
`uname -s` 会显示 `MINGW64_NT-...`，`uname -o` 是 `Msys`，正是 Git for Windows 内嵌的 MinGW64 环境。

装好之后，新会话里的模型看到的是 `bash` 工具，而不是 `pwsh`。命令通过 `bash -c` 执行，
因此不再经过 PowerShell 的 cmdlet 拦截、`$env:` 变量语法、反引号转义和控制台代码页：

- 引号、反斜杠、`$`、反引号、换行都按 POSIX/bash 规则解析；
- stdout / stderr / 重定向文件都是 UTF-8 字节；
- 托管变量是 `$DSH_HOME`、`$DSH_PROFILE`、`$DSH_PROFILE_DIR`、`$DSH_SESSION_ID`、`$DSH_SHELL`；
- 每次调用仍然是新进程，工作目录、超时、后台 job、输出截断和沙箱行为沿用 DSH 的
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox` 机制。

## 安装前提

- Windows。
- Git for Windows（默认 `C:\Program Files\Git`）。Git 自带的 MinGW64 bash 就是目标 shell；
  不需要 `C:\msys64`，也不需要把 `bash` 加到系统 PATH。
- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 系列（`engines.dsh` 限定在 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`）。

自动探测顺序：常见 Git 安装目录 → `git --exec-path` 反推出的 Git 根目录 → `PATH` 里的
`bash.exe`。最后一种会跳过 `C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe`（WSL 启动器），并运行一次
`uname -s; uname -o` 确认选中的确实是 MinGW/MSYS；便携版 Git、scoop、非标准目录都能通过
`git --exec-path` 或 `MINGW_BASH` 找到。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 的插件管理器里：

```text
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=github:Scorpiour/dsh-mingw
```

或者从 CLI：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Scorpiour/dsh-mingw
```

需要固定发布版本时使用 tag：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Scorpiour/dsh-mingw#v0.1.1
```

### 从本地目录安装（开发）

在克隆目录或源码目录中直接安装：

```text
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<克隆目录>
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <克隆目录>
```

安装会改写三个 preset 定义（`standard`、`ptc` 和 `cordis`），不动宿主现有的 PowerShell
executor。**现有会话保持原样**；新建会话才会使用 MinGW bash。`minimal` preset（持久
pwsh）未改动。

## 验证

新建一个会话，让模型运行：

```bash
uname -o; pwd; printf '中文\n'; echo "$DSH_PROFILE"
command -v pwsh || echo no-pwsh
command -v bash
```

期望看到：

- `Msys`（不是 `GNU/Linux`）；
- 当前目录的 POSIX 形式，例如 `/e/Develop/dsh-win-mingw`；
- 正常输出 `中文`；
- `DSH_PROFILE` 为当前 profile；
- `pwsh` 不存在；
- `bash` 解析到 Git/MSYS 的路径。

## 配置

执行器行在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `mingw-shell` 下，可用字段：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bashPath` | 自动探测 | 显式指定 `bash.exe`，也可以指定包含 `bash.exe` 的目录 |
| `verifyBash` | `true` | 是否运行 `uname` 验证选中的 shell 是 MinGW/MSYS |
| `pathPrepend` | `[]` | 追加到子进程 `PATH` 的 Windows 目录（位于 bash 目录之后） |

优先级：`bashPath` > `MINGW_BASH` 环境变量 > 常见 Git/MSYS2 安装位置 >
`git --exec-path` 反推的 Git 根目录 > `PATH`。
显式值不可用时会直接报错，不会悄悄换用别的 bash。

`MINGW_BASH` 对每个命令生效，改环境变量不需要重装 bundle。例如 Git 装在非标准位置：

```powershell
$env:MINGW_BASH = 'D:\PortableGit\bin\bash.exe'
```

如果 Git/MSYS 装在非标准位置，或用的是 scoop / 便携版，优先设置 `MINGW_BASH`。

## 它是怎么接进去的

`cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖 `preset-standard`、`preset-ptc` 和 `preset-cordis` 的完整 `config`，
把原来的两行 `tool-bash` / `tool-pwsh` 换成：

- 非 Windows：仍然挂载原来的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`（宿主 bash executor）；
- Windows：挂载一个 `isolate: { shell: true }` 的 group，里面依次是
  `MingwBashExecutor`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`、MinGW 提示段。

因为 `shell` 服务被隔离在 group 里，宿主由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox` 提供的
PowerShell executor 不会被替换。旧会话和 `minimal` 仍然能用原来的 PowerShell
工具，不会因为这次安装而坏掉。

- `executor.js` — `MingwBashExecutor extends SandboxBashExecutor`：只重写 `resolve()`，
  把 `PATH` 改成 Git Bash 目录优先，并固定 `TERM`/`NO_COLOR`/UTF-8/Python 相关变量。
  沙箱、超时、后台 job、输出上限全部继承。preset 行引用 `@local/dsh-win-mingw/executor`
  这个独立入口，避免热更新时复用旧的模块代。
- `index.js` — 包根入口，转发到 `executor.js`。
- `mingw.js` — 探测和验证 bash；也是独立测试的入口。
- `prompt.js` — 一小段系统提示，放在 bash 工具说明之后（order 1005），告诉模型这是
  Git for Windows 自带的 MinGW64 bash，而不是 PowerShell。
- `scripts/build-patch.mjs` — 从 DSH checkout 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` preset 文件
  重新生成 `cordis.patch.yml`。升级 DSH 后重跑：

  ```sh
  node scripts/build-patch.mjs
  ```

  默认读取 `DSH_CHECKOUT`，否则自动寻找同级的 `../deepseek-harness`；也可以显式传入
  checkout 路径。脚本共用 `scripts/dev-paths.mjs` 的探测逻辑。

## 测试

```sh
node --check index.js
node --check executor.js
node --check prompt.js
node --check mingw.js
node tests/mingw.test.mjs
node tests/import.test.mjs
node tests/executor.test.mjs
```

`tests/import.test.mjs` 用 dev-only 的 resolve hook 模拟宿主对 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的
runtime resolution；`tests/executor.test.mjs` 则挂载真实的
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy` 和本执行器，实际跑一条 `bash -c` 命令，验证
`Msys`、POSIX 路径、UTF-8 中文和 `DSH_*` 注入。`tests/` 和 `scripts/` 不包含在发布用的
`files` 里。

`tests/import-live-resolution.mjs` 和 `tests/group-mount.test.mjs` 需要真实的 DSH 源码
checkout 和已安装 profile。默认会寻找同级的 `../deepseek-harness`，profile 默认是
`~/.dsh/profiles/web`；也可以用环境变量覆盖。找不到时脚本会直接报出缺失的路径，而不是
静默跳过：

```powershell
$env:DSH_CHECKOUT = 'D:\src\deepseek-harness'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web"
node tests/import-live-resolution.mjs
node tests/group-mount.test.mjs
```

`DSH_CHECKOUT` 也用于 `scripts/build-patch.mjs`。

## 排错：`agent-preset/invalid ... never start`

这个错误表示 Loader 没能导入 preset 里的模块；UI 只显示 audit 的 `never started`，
具体的导入错误在**启动 DSH 的终端**里（Loader 的 `logger.error`）。

最常见原因：DSH 进程在插件文件更新前已经缓存了 `package.json` / 模块代。`./executor`
是后加的导出，旧进程会把它当成不存在的包路径，于是 `mingw-shell` 这一行没有 fiber。

处理：**重启 DSH 一次，不要重装**。然后新建会话。

在一个新进程里验证模块可导入：

```sh
node tests/import-live-resolution.mjs
```

应输出：

```text
imported: [ 'Config', 'MingwBashExecutor', 'default' ]
```

同一个脚本还会打印当前 profile 解析出的 linked root；再用
`node tests/group-mount.test.mjs` 可以验证 `isolate: { shell: true }` 的 group
能正常启动 `mingw-shell` 行。

## 已知限制

- `workspace-write` 模式下，MinGW bash 本身和 Git 的 `/tmp` 与 Windows ACL 私有临时目录
  的组合还没有做端到端验证。当前 profile 默认是 `danger-full-access`；如果切到
  `workspace-write` 后遇到临时文件写入被拒绝，请先切回 `danger-full-access` 或反馈。
- 命令里显式调用 `powershell` / `cmd /c` 时，仍然由它们执行。
- `minimal` preset 保持原样，仍是持久 pwsh。
- 旧会话不会热切换；需要新建会话。
- 如果刚安装后当前进程仍缓存了旧的模块代，重启 DSH 一次即可；新会话会使用
  `@local/dsh-win-mingw/executor` 这个独立入口，不受包根旧缓存影响。
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox` / `dsh-bash-local` 的当前 API，DSH 升级后先跑
  测试和 `build-patch.mjs`，再安装更新。

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-failover — 模型故障自动转移

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：模型请求失败时，自动切换到「所选供应商池」中的下一个模型重试。

## 它解决什么

DSH 官方模型选择是「一次选定、失败就报错」。官方 `dsh-llm-retry` 只在**同一供应商**内重试——
如果供应商整体限流/配额耗尽/宕掉，重试 5 次后这一轮仍然失败。

本插件在**供应商之间**做故障转移：

- **池 = 所选供应商下的全部模型**：只选一个供应商 → 该供应商内所有模型轮询；选多个 → 按顺序跨供应商池轮询。
- **失败即切**：`RATE_LIMIT` / `QUOTA` / `TIMEOUT` / `SERVER` / `TRANSPORT` / `EMPTY_RESPONSE` 等
  可配置的机器可路由 code 触发；每个候选模型只试一次，绝不重复试同一个。
- **池尽即还原**：整个池都失败时交还原错误，不掩盖真实故障。
- **运行时可控**：`model_failover` 工具随时 `status / set / clear / enable / disable`，不用改配置重启。
- **可粘滞**：`sticky: true` 时转移后该会话持续使用新模型；默认只转移当次故障。

## 机制（与 DSH 官方扩展点对齐）

1. `agent/request-error` 瀑布流（官方重试插件同款扩展点）：上游 `dsh-llm-retry` 同供应商重试耗尽后
   返回 `undefined`，本插件接住失败 → 从池中挑下一个未试过的模型 → 返回 `{ kind: "retry" }`，
   agent-loop 重新 `prepareRequest` 并重发。
2. `agent/request` 瀑布流：把待生效目标写进本次请求的 provider/model，成为实际发送的模型
   （与 dsh-session-conductor 的成员模型切换同一模式）。
3. 失败分类只认 `failure.code`（机器可路由），绝不解析报错文本。
4. 状态存 `<DSH_HOME>/model-failover/state.json`：运行时池、粘滞目标、modelCatalog 快照、最近事件。
   不写会话事件（Session 拒绝未知 type 的非 ignorable 事件）。

## 安装

本仓库是一个 Host-only bundle（无第三方依赖、无需构建）：

```
dsh-model-failover/
├── index.js            # 宿主插件主体
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle patch（insert 一行）
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch 声明
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件市场显示名/描述
└── icon.svg
```

通过 DSH 的 Plugin Manager 安装该目录（`install_bundle`，target 传本目录绝对路径），
或把目录放进 profile 的 `node_modules/` 并在 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-model-failover
      name: dsh-model-failover
      config: {}
```

重启 DSH 生效。

## 配置（cordis.patch.yml 行 config，全部有默认值）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `providers` | `[]` | 默认供应商池（按顺序）；空 = 用 `model_failover set` 运行时设置 |
| `retryableCodes` | `RATE_LIMIT, QUOTA, ACCOUNT_QUOTA, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT, EMPTY_RESPONSE, NO_ADAPTER` | 触发转移的失败码 |
| `sticky` | `false` | 转移后粘滞该会话直到 `clear`；false = 仅当次故障内转移 |
| `maxFailoverAttempts` | `0` | 单次故障最多转移几个候选（0 = 整个池子） |

## 熔断（抗抖动）

单个模型偶发失败不立刻拉黑，但持续失败会被"熔断"一段时间，避免每次请求都先撞一遍坏模型：

- **模型级**：`failureThreshold`（默认 2）次失败发生在 `burstWindowMs`（默认 300s）窗口内 → 该路由冷却 `circuitCooldownMs`（默认 60s），期间池候选自动跳过它；
- **供应商级**：同一供应商下已有 `providerThreshold`（默认 2）个模型同时熔断 → 该供应商池内全部模型一起冷却（整个平台挂掉时不再逐个撞）；
- **主动绕行**：请求命中已熔断路由时，`agent/request` 直接改道到池中第一个健康模型，不必再失败一次（`preemptiveSwitch`，默认开）；
- **自动恢复**：冷却到期自动复活；`llm/stream` 观察到成功终态时清除该路由熔断并打上"今日可用"标记；
- 全部候选都在熔断时仍按池顺序尝试（不把用户卡死）。

状态持久化在 `state.json` 的 `circuits` / `success`，重启后冷却仍有效。
## 运行时工具 `model_failover`

| action | 参数 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | — | 查看开关/池（含候选模型列表）/触发码/最近 8 条转移事件 |
| `set` | `providers: ["wb","agnes"]` | 设置运行时池（优先于 config.providers），立即生效 |
| `clear` | — | 清空运行时池与粘滞目标，回退配置池 |
| `enable` / `disable` | — | 运行时总闸 |

示例：

```text
model_failover set providers=["wb","agnes"]   → 池 = wb 全部模型 + agnes 全部模型（按此顺序）
model_failover status                          → 池 6 个候选：wb/cn:a, wb/cn:b, … agnes/global:x
```

## 图形界面（输入框右下角）

插件自带浏览器半边：在输入框右下角、官方「模型选择器」左侧有一个 **⇄ 故障转移** 按钮，
点开后可以：

- 勾选一个或多个供应商（池 = 所选供应商内的全部模型，实时显示每个供应商的模型数）
- 保存 / 清空 / 停用·启用，点一下立即生效（与 `model_failover` 工具共用同一份状态）
- 查看池内每个模型的状态徽标（🟢 今日可用 / 🔴 熔断冷却中带倒计时 / ⚪ 未试）与熔断策略、最近几次转移事件

数据与操作走宿主同源路由 `GET /api/model-failover/status`、`POST /api/model-failover/{set,clear,toggle}`。
新增/修改 Client 代码后需要重启 DSH 并刷新页面（桌面端不做热加载）。

## 与其它插件的协同

- **dsh-llm-retry（官方）**：天然协同——上游先同供应商重试（自带退避），耗尽后本插件接住做跨供应商转移。
- **dsh-session-conductor（成员模型切换）**：两者都在 `agent/request` 改写模型。本插件在有待生效转移目标
  或 sticky 粘滞时生效；显式成员模型不会被无故障时改写（无 pending 时不干预）。

## 已知边界

- 池成员来自 `modelCatalog`；目录不可用时用最近的落盘快照（重启后仍可用）。
- 图片消息 + 纯文本模型：本插件不检查候选模型的输入模态（v1），如池内含纯文本模型可能在该轮被拒。
- 转移发生在同一步内，可能增加该步耗时（每个候选一次完整请求尝试 + 官方退避）。
- 不做「定时轮询」：只有失败才转移（按设计）。

## 测试

```bash
node --test test/unit.mjs
```

覆盖：池展开（单/多供应商、去重、未知跳过）、失败码过滤、路由改写、全链路
（失败 → 转移 → 重试 → 池尽还原）、运行时 set 立即生效、sticky/非 sticky 行为、状态持久化 + 快照兜底。

## License

MIT

# DSH WorkBuddy Connect Community

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

由 Tang Yixiao 维护的社区分叉，基于 Corrine Hu 的 MIT 项目 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)，保留其原有功能与版权。本项目面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2，复用本机已登录的 WorkBuddy（国内版）或 WorkBuddy AI（国际版），并保留 `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-ai` provider ID、现有账号数据和设置。

社区版还对发往服务端的 system/developer 提示词做有限的产品称谓兼容处理，仅替换普通说明文本及已验证的固定 DSH 说明句中的精确称谓。用户、助手和工具消息、工具定义、图片块及文本块元数据保持原样；围栏代码块会跳过处理。普通文本中包含路径分隔符、引号、代码标记或可识别文件扩展名的行也会跳过，唯一额外处理是行首精确匹配已验证的 DSH 固定说明句时替换该句内的称谓，同一行后续内容保持原样。没有任何标记的纯文字文件名无法可靠地与正文区分，建议用反引号标记。这项本地处理不代表官方支持，也不保证上游服务持续可用。

## 安装或替换

仅支持 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**。Windows 是目前唯一完成本机验证的平台。macOS 和 Linux 尚未进行本分叉的实时验证。

从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/latest) 下载并按 DSH 支持的插件安装方式安装独立包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community/releases/latest/download/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community.tgz
```

如原版插件已安装，先保存当前版本和配置，再通过 DSH 支持的方式替换为社区版。原版与社区版不能同时启用；两者使用相同的 provider ID 和账号登录数据。失败时卸载社区版并恢复先前保存的原版。不要删除 WorkBuddy 登录信息或聊天数据。首版通过 GitHub Release 分发，暂不发布到 npm。

## 兼容性与限制

插件直接复用 WorkBuddy 桌面应用的登录状态与服务接口，模型目录、请求和额度显示依赖第三方服务状态。服务接口可能变化或不可用；社区维护不意味着 WorkBuddy、腾讯或 DeepSeek 的授权或背书。请遵守相关服务条款。

本软件不包含账号凭据、用户会话或运行时数据。凭据只从本机应用或 DSH 自己保存的凭据副本读取。

## 来源与许可

本仓库保留原项目 Git 历史，维护分叉基于上游提交 [`c0ed88e3712d3bb2e2deff5fddec1181e6222973`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect/commit/c0ed88e3712d3bb2e2deff5fddec1181e6222973)。原作者 Corrine Hu 的 MIT 版权声明保留；分叉维护者为 Tang Yixiao。详见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE) 与 [第三方声明](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt)。
