| Before (51 flat rows) | After (grouped & folded) |
|---|---|
| ![Before: a flat list of 51 subagents](docs/before.png) | ![After: History 13 / Previous 4 / Current 4](docs/after.png) |

Or manually:

```bash
pnpm add dsh-subagent-fold
```

Then register in the profile's `package.json`:

```bash
node tools/install.cjs --dry-run                  # preview only

```

Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH.

### Standard bundle (recommended)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Sourcetree-style Git workspace — changes, diff, history, branches, push, AI-written commit messages and AI-assisted conflict resolution in a full-height panel
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-git-tree

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the Web GUI a Sourcetree-style Git workspace: a full-height panel with the left rail Sourcetree has (Working Copy / branches / tags / remotes), a staged/unstaged file list, and a diff viewer — inside DSH, next to your conversation, instead of in another app.

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

![dsh-git-tree](docs/media/cover.png)

[![Watch the 35-second intro](docs/media/promo-loop.gif)](docs/media/promo.mp4)

`35-second intro (mp4, 3.6 MB)` · [`poster`](docs/media/poster.png)

## What it does today

Version 0.10.0 is the **local workbench slice**: file status, history, search and local branches — read, stage, commit, switch branches and inspect any commit inside the panel, push the current branch, and let a DSH model write the commit message. Fetch/pull, remote branches and remote management are not implemented yet.

- **A `main` panel**, opened from the `Git` row in DSH's left icon rail — the same kind of seat the Plugins page uses, so it gets the full centre column, the window chrome inset, and DSH's theme for free.
- **Repository switcher** in the toolbar: pick any workspace registered in DSH; every route then runs against that repository. Workspaces can be pinned (pinned ones list first, in pin order) and the rest are ordered by how often you switch to them, then by the last time you did.
- **Branch + sync state**: current branch, upstream, ahead/behind, repository root.
- **Sourcetree's change model**: conflict, staged and unstaged groups with counts; renames keep their original path; a file changed on both sides appears in both groups (driven by `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch -z`).
- **Structured diff**: parsed on the host into files → hunks → lines, rendered with dual line numbers, hunk headers, whole-row tints and `+N −M`.
- **Stage / unstage / commit**: per-row checkbox, hover menu, file-level action in the diff header, a commit box with author, branch, staged count and ⌘↵ — plus a `--`-guarded, conflict-checked host route for each write.
- **History view**: commits newest-first with a lane graph, description / short SHA / author / date columns, an "all branches / current branch only" switch and paged loading (200 per page).
- **Commit detail**: select a commit to see its message, author, date, parents, refs and changed files; pick a file for its in-commit diff; follow a parent link to jump.
- **Search view**: find commits by message, author or file path; results reuse the history list and detail.
- **Branches**: click a branch to browse its history, double-click to check out; create, rename and delete local branches from the rail. Checkout refuses a dirty working copy instead of stashing your changes.
- **Right-click actions**: file rows offer commit (stage + focus the message), stage/unstage, discard changes, delete file / delete untracked file and copy path; branch rows offer checkout, rename, delete and copy name; commit rows offer copy SHA, new branch from this commit and copy message. Destructive items confirm first and only live items are red.
- **Fetch and pull**: Fetch reads the remote's refs (pruned) so ahead/behind is current; Pull fast-forwards the current branch to its upstream, or to `origin/<same branch>` when the branch tracks nothing. Fetch and pull run as two separate actions, the panel fetches once when it opens, and a diverged branch asks before the plugin merges the remote in — conflicts land in the conflict view.
- **Push**: push the current branch to its upstream (setting the upstream on first push). Never forces; authentication and non-fast-forward failures are translated into readable next steps.
- **Commit and push**: a checkbox in the commit card pushes right after a successful commit. A failed push never rolls the commit back.
- **Foldable commit card**: the card folds to one strip — author, branch, staged count and the first line of the message — so the diff gets the space back. The Fold/Unfold pill sits at the right of the metadata row in both states; clicking the strip unfolds too, and the fold is remembered across reloads. A row action that opens the message box unfolds it first.
- **Conflict view and AI resolution**: a conflicted file shows the working-tree copy with its `<<<<<<<` markers rendered line by line (ours tinted blue, theirs amber) instead of an empty "no differences" pane. "Resolve with AI" asks the selected DSH model to merge that one file, previews the result as a diff, and writes it only after Apply. The conflict can be restored with one action (`git checkout --merge`), and "Mark resolved" (`git add`) is a separate, deliberate step — applying never stages.
- **AI commit message**: the ✨ button in the commit card writes the message from the diff of the files that commit would include — the staged rows when there are any, otherwise every working-tree row — and the model chip picks which DSH model does it. The picker is the live DSH model catalog (every registered provider, grouped), the choice is remembered per DSH home, and the call itself goes through DSH's own `llm` service; there is no second provider configuration in this plugin. It only fills the text box: you still review and press Commit. The diff of the selected files is sent to the model you chose.
- **Local actions**: reveal the repository in Finder or open it in Terminal (macOS).
- **Live**: the panel polls status every 2s while visible and refetches immediately after a write.
- **Small write surface by construction**: stage/unstage/commit, discard, delete, branch create-rename-delete, checkout, merge into the current branch, and a push of the current branch that never forces. No `reset --hard`, no force-push, no amend, no rebase, no stash route exists.

## Status

| Area | 0.10.0 |
| --- | --- |
| `main` panel + sidebar launcher | done |
| repository switcher (DSH workspaces) | done |
| branch / ahead / behind / references rail | done |
| conflict / staged / unstaged groups | done |
| structured per-file diff | done |
| stage / unstage / commit | done |
| AI commit message + DSH model picker | done |
| history view (lanes, paging, filters) | done |
| commit detail + in-commit diff | done |
| search (message / author / path) | done |
| branch navigation + checkout | done |
| branch create / rename / delete | done |
| right-click actions + discard / delete | done |
| push / commit and push | done |
| Finder / Terminal | done |
| auto refresh | done |
| right-sidebar tab (compact mode) | not yet |
| push current branch | done |
| fetch / pull | done |
| remote branches / remote management | not yet |
| merge into current branch | done |
| conflict view + AI conflict resolution | done |
| rebase / stash / manual 3-way merge editor | not yet |
| large-repo virtualisation | not planned |
| agent-shared operations | not yet |

The full plan, including the measured UI spec the layout is built from, is in [`docs/PLAN.md`](docs/PLAN.md).

## Design notes

The panel copies Sourcetree's **information architecture**, not its chrome. The layout numbers are measured, not guessed: they come from the running app's accessibility tree and from decoding its Interface Builder archives — see [`docs/sourcetree-ui.md`](docs/sourcetree-ui.md) and [`docs/ib-summary.md`](docs/ib-summary.md).

Two consequences worth knowing:

- Sourcetree's diff has **no syntax highlighting**; it distinguishes lines with whole-row colour only. This panel does the same on purpose — in a diff, "which lines changed" beats "which token is a keyword".
- Every colour here is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token, so light and dark both work without a second design. `npm test` fails if a hardcoded colour ever ships.

## AI commit message

The ✨ button and the model chip in the commit card are one small, bounded feature:

- **Which model**: the list is `ctx.llm`'s live catalog — every provider DSH has registered, with the models it advertises. It is the same list the DSH model picker shows, fetched per request, so a model you add in DSH settings appears here without a restart of the panel.
- **Which files**: the diff of the files this commit would include — the staged rows when anything is staged, otherwise the working-tree rows. Unt

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-sync **LAN session sync for DSH.** Every DSH that has this plugin discovers the others on the local network, lists their sessions, and can pull or push conversations over plain HTTP. The nickname you give a device lives **only on your machine** — the peer can go offline, reboot, or change IP and come back, and you still see the name you gave it.
[![CI](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/stargazers) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4d6bfe)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) 🌏 [简体中文](./README_ZH.md) · **English**
> **0.8.0 UI rebuild**: session desk, whole-row selection, selection bar, transfer dock and settings were redrawn. The full draft (19 scenes, dark/light, zh/en) is in [`docs/redesign/index.html`](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/tree/main/docs/redesign); implementation mapping and acceptance are in [`DESIGN.md`](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/blob/main/docs/redesign/DESIGN.md). The whole-session file transfer design (chunks / resume) is in [`session-bundle-transfer.md`](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/blob/main/docs/architecture/session-bundle-transfer.md) (next phase). ![Session Sync panel](docs/preview.png) ![Planning a transfer: pick a folder, confirm every item](docs/preview-transfer.png) ## ✨ Features | | | |---|---| | **📡 Zero-config discovery**
UDP broadcast on every IPv4 interface with a 4s beacon. A peer that just appeared gets an immediate unicast reply, so new devices show up without waiting for the next round. | **🏷️ Local-only nicknames**
Stored in `/session-sync/state.json` and keyed by a stable **device id** (uuid) — not IP, not hostname. The peer renaming itself never overwrites your label. | | **🗂️ Browse · pull · push**
See each device's sessions with title, cwd and time; pull one into this machine or push one of yours out. Imported rows are marked as pulled. | **🔐 SHA-256 verification**
Exports carry `sha256 = SHA-256(JSON.stringify({format, session, events}))`; imports compare it **before writing a byte** and refuse with HTTP 409 `checksum-mismatch`. Each row has a *Verify* action. | | **🔁 Optional auto-pull**
Every 20s, pull sessions you have not pulled yet. Content fingerprints (not ids) stop two machines with auto-pull on from bouncing one conversation back and forth forever. | **🎨 Native look, i18n**
Built from DSH design tokens (colors, radii, type scale, 0.2s transitions), so light/dark follow the host. Language follows DSH by default, with explicit 中文 / English overrides. | | **🔎 Find sessions fast**
Search (press `/`), 全部 / 未拉取 / 已拉取 filters, sort by time or title, and ↑↓ / Space / Enter navigation. Rows stay quiet: one status chip, with 校验 and 拉取 on hover or focus. | **🧰 Tidy devices & queue**
The rail only selects; rename, copy address, refresh, push and forget live in the stage header ⋯. Transfers sit in a bottom dock that expands into the queue; network/advanced options stay folded. | | **🪟 Master / detail**
Devices sit in a left column (session count + chevron, the whole row is the target) while the selected device's sessions stay visible on the right — no hidden "click a card to expand". The first online device is selected automatically. | **🧭 Device actions**
Push here, rename, copy address, refresh and remove live in the stage header ⋯; rename happens inline in the header. | | **🖱️ Drag, select, drop**
Select one or many sessions and drag them onto any known folder **or straight onto a workspace row in DSH's own sidebar**: the header takes the whole group, a session row takes the pointer's position and shows an insertion line between rows. Every drop asks for confirmation and names the workspace it will land in. | **🚦 Confirmed transfer queue**
Repeated pushes/pulls are detected up front; a dialog lets you keep the local copy, overwrite it, or drop that single item. The rest of the queue keeps running in order. | | **⚡ One-click sync**
**Sync all** / **Push all** plan the whole device in one go, skip sessions already present by content fingerprint, and report each row as done, skipped or failed. | **🌐 Cross-subnet scanning**
Broadcast stays on the local segment; add CIDRs, IPs or `ip:port` under *Cross-subnet scan*. CIDRs get silent UDP discovery packets, single IPs are also probed over HTTP on 47802–47817 — a firewall that drops UDP no longer hides the peer. | | **🚦 Queue that shows its work**
Each transfer is a card with spinner, measured duration, failure reason and a progress track; pulls stream their bytes so the card and the sticky bar show **live percentages**. The queue runs several workers sized from the CPU count (capped at 5), or a fixed 1–16 concurrency you choose. | ### Three UI promises - **“This device” is always the first row, and one IP is never two devices.** The card shows this machine's name, `LAN address:sync port` and running version. Any peer whose address belongs to this host is grouped underneath it as “other DSH instances on this machine” (browsable and pushable, so cross-profile sync still works) instead of counting as a device — the list and its counters only ever mean **other machines**. - **Untitled sessions carry `#first-8-chars-of-session-id`.** A pile of “Untitled” rows looks identical; the id is what tells them apart. The pull plan's “already present” flag is keyed by the same peer + session id, so renaming a session never turns a duplicate into a fresh copy. - **A crashing UI is never blank.** Render errors hit an error boundary that prints platform, Node version, host version, ports, UA and a stack summary, with *Reload* / *Copy diagnostics*. If Windows still shows nothing, paste that block into an issue. ## 🚀 Installation ```sh # From GitHub (recommended, tracks the latest commit) dsh plugin --profile web add github:XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync # Or from npm (scoped name; the unscoped dsh-session-sync belongs to another project) dsh plugin --profile web add @xxgxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync ``` Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (the version bundled with the current desktop app) and Node 22+. Then restart the DSH desktop app (host-side changes load at boot; open pages pick up the new UI on refresh). The page footer shows the build that is actually running — if it reads an older number than the latest release, the process has not been restarted yet. The install is auto-activated: the package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own. Prebuilt tarball (no build step):
Manual install from a local checkout ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/profiles//package.json { "dependencies": { "dsh-session-sync": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-sync" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-session-sync"] } } } ``` ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/ && pnpm install ```
Confirm it loaded — the log shows: ```text [dsh-session-sync] ready: device , sync port 47802, discovery port 47801 [dsh-session-sync] discovered (192.168.1.7:47802) ``` ## 🧭 Where it lives A **Session Sync** row appears under **Plugins** in the left sidebar (`sidebar.panellist` + keyed `main` panel, id `session-sync`). The same component is also registered as **Settings → Session Sync** (`settings.section`). - **This machine** — the name other devices see; changing it broadcasts immediately. - **Devices** — online/offline, last heartbeat, session count, platform and version. - **Rename / Forget** — a per-device nickname for this machine only. plugins.readme_text:
# @xiciyang/training-sft

用**真实 GPU** 对一个基座模型做 LoRA 监督微调（SFT），并把每一步变成可审计的产物：数据准备、训练、合并、验收、回退，全部留下哈希链与机器可读报告。

这是 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件包；也可以把它当作一个普通的 Node 库调用（`src/index.mjs` 的导出面）。

## 它解决的问题

「训练跑完了」和「训练真的改变了权重」是两件事。本包在训练前后对权重取指纹，**空操作训练（lr=0、数据为空、步数没生效）会被判为失败**，而不是记成一次成功的 run。精度侧同理：验收要求先过「测量是否有效」再谈「数值是否达标」——输出退化（困惑度等于词表大小）不会被当成 0% 损失。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add github:xiciyang/training-sft
# 或从 npm（元数据）。注意：本包的运行依赖是 @xiciyang/* 系列库，已发布到 npm。
```

要求：

- Node.js >= 20（DSH 侧），`engines.dsh >= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`
- 真实训练需要：NVIDIA GPU + 容器运行时 + 训练镜像；缺失时 `training_sft_health` 会报明是哪一层不可用，而不是笼统地「不健康」
- Python 侧框架（torch / transformers / peft / trl / accelerate）在 `optionalDependencies` 里显式声明，缺哪个报哪个

## 工具面（DSH）

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `training_sft_prepare` | 数据准备：去重、确定性切分、去泄漏（train/val/test 三组交集必须为空）、PII 剔除（只剔除不改写源文件）、血缘与内容哈希 |
| `training_sft_train` | 训练：预算闸门（步数/GPU 小时）、权重指纹守卫、checkpoint 保留、审计链 |
| `training_sft_merge` | 合并 LoRA 适配器到基座 |
| `training_sft_validate` | 验收：双重门禁（先判测量是否有效，再判数值变化），产出机器可读的 `eval-result` |
| `training_sft_rollback` | 回退：回到指定 run 的状态；purge 只允许删 run 目录，越界拒绝 |
| `training_sft_get_report` | 取人类可读报告 |
| `training_sft_health` | 环境自检：GPU / 容器 / 镜像 / 基座模型 / 依赖，逐项给出可用性 |

## 配置（不把本机布局写死）

| 环境变量 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `DSH_BASE_MODEL` | 基座模型本地目录（只读）。未设置时健康检查会指出缺这一项，而不是猜一个路径 |
| `DSH_ALPACA_PATH` | 原始数据集文件路径（复现数据准备测试时需要） |
| `DSH_SHARD_PATH` | 预处理语料分片路径（引用时用） |
| `TRAINING_SFT_ROOT` | 运行目录根（默认 `~/.ai-infra`） |

硬件与后端都是可替换的：基座路径、镜像名、容器运行时、设备都不写死。没有 GPU 时，纯逻辑测试与契约测试仍然可以跑。

## 测试

```bash
node tests/run.mjs          # 单元 + 契约 + 缺陷回归
```

测试分两类：**纯逻辑/契约**（任何机器都应绿）与**需要本机历史产物的判据自检**。后者在产物不存在时显式 `SKIP` 并写明原因，不伪装成通过——汇总行会打印 skipped 数。CI 上看到 skip 属预期，看到 fail 才是问题。

## 安全边界

- 训练与合并都需要显式确认令牌（每类一次、24 小时内同类操作免重复确认；高风险操作每次都要）
- 预算超限直接拒绝，不「先跑再说」
- 回退只作用于本插件自己的 run 目录

## 许可

BSD-3-Clause。见 `LICENSE`。

plugins.description: Cloudflare 全功能管家 for DeepSeek Harness：接入官方 Code Mode MCP，search + execute 覆盖 2,500+ API（Workers / Pages / DNS / R2 / KV / D1 / Zero Trust），OAuth 2.1 与 API Token 双认证，带可视化设置面板。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cloudflare-codemode

**把 Cloudflare 的全部 API 交给 AI —— 通过官方 Code Mode MCP，不封装任何单个接口。**

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) 提供 Cloudflare 全产品读写能力：
AI 拿到 `search` 与 `execute` 两个工具，就能动态访问 **2,500+ 个 Cloudflare API 端点**，
覆盖 Workers、DNS、R2、KV、D1、Pages、Zero Trust、AI Gateway……全部产品线。

附带一个可视化设置面板，支持 **OAuth 2.1 浏览器授权**与 **API Token** 两种接入方式，
凭据只保存在本机。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2f6f4f)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.1--rc.2-4d6bfe)](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933)](https://nodejs.org/)

---

## 快速开始

```bash
# 从 npm 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cloudflare-codemode

# 或从 GitHub 源码安装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
```

桌面端把 `web` 换成 `desktop`。装完**重启 DSH**、按 `Ctrl + Shift + R` 刷新页面，
进入 **设置 → Cloudflare 全功能管家** 完成 OAuth 授权或填入 API Token。

> 也可以通过市场源安装：把 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode/main/market.json`
> 加到 **设置 → 插件 → 市场源**。

---
## 这是什么

Cloudflare 在 2025 年上线了官方的 **Code Mode MCP 服务器** `https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp`。
它不暴露几百个固定工具，而是只给两个：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `search` | 在完整 OpenAPI 规格里检索端点、参数与请求体结构 |
| `execute` | 执行一段 JavaScript，通过 `cloudflare.request()` 调用任意 Cloudflare API |

配合 `docs`（文档问答）与 `whoami`（身份确认），AI 可以先查规格、再写代码调用——
这比"为每个产品手写一个工具"覆盖广得多，也永远不会因为 Cloudflare 加新接口而失效。

**本插件的职责很简单：让 DSH 里的模型用上这四个工具。**

---

## 为什么需要这个插件

DSH 自带 MCP 客户端（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`），但它定位是"配置即连接"：
地址、认证头都写死在 profile 配置里，改一次就要编辑 YAML 并重启宿主。

而 Cloudflare 的凭据是**会变的**——OAuth 访问令牌两小时过期、API Token 可能被吊销重建。
把明文 Token 写进 `cordis.patch.yml` 既不安全，也不灵活。

本插件的做法是：**在本地起一个只做认证注入的代理**，MCP 协议仍由官方客户端处理。

---

## 工作原理

```
┌──────────────┐
│   AI 模型     │
└──────┬───────┘
       │  mcp__cloudflare__search / execute / docs / whoami
       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client  │  ← DSH 官方包，负责 MCP 协议
│   （随 DSH 一起提供）          │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │  Streamable HTTP
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  127.0.0.1:18923/mcp         │  ← 本插件：注入 Authorization 的代理
│  每次请求重读本机凭据文件       │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │  OAuth / Bearer Token
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ https://mcp.cloudflare.com   │  ← Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

**这层代理换来三件事：**

1. **密钥不进配置** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有端口号，凭据在独立文件里（权限 `0600`）。
2. **改 Token 立刻生效** —— 代理逐请求读取凭据，面板保存后下一次调用就换上了，无需重启。
3. **OAuth 自动续期** —— 访问令牌过期时在代理内透明刷新，对 MCP 客户端完全无感。

本插件**不封装任何 Cloudflare 接口**。全部 2,500+ 端点都来自 Cloudflare 自己维护的规格。

---

## 功能

- **全产品读写**：DNS、Workers、Pages、R2、KV、D1、Zero Trust、R2、Images、Stream、Logpush……
- **双认证**：OAuth 2.1 浏览器授权（PKCE + 动态客户端注册）或 API Token
- **可视化面板**：设置页「Cloudflare 全功能管家」——认证切换、连接状态、工具数量、权限清单
- **连接自检**：一键跑完整 MCP 握手（initialize → tools/list），如实回报发现的工具
- **状态实时**：显示 MCP 桥接是否已连接、已注册的工具名
- **零 DSH 依赖**：Host 半只用 Node 内置模块，不 `import` 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`，因此不受内核版本闸门限制

---

## 安装

> 需要 DSH **0.2.x**（已验证 `0.2.1-rc.2`），Node.js **≥ 22**。

### 方式一：GitHub 源（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
```

桌面端（profile 名为 `desktop`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
```

### 方式二：DSH Desktop 插件管理器

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，填入仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode
```

安装完成后**完全退出应用并重新打开**。

### 方式三：本地目录

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-cloudflare-codemode
```

### 方式四：插件市场源

本仓库自带 `market.json`（format 1）。在 **设置 → 插件** 里把下面的市场索引地址加进去，
即可在 Discover / 市场页直接看到并安装本插件：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aikunx/dsh-cloudflare-codemode/main/market.json
```

### 安装后

1. **重启 DSH**（新增 Host 插件必须重启才会加载）
2. 浏览器按 `Ctrl + Shift + R` 强制刷新页面
3. 进入 **设置 → Cloudflare 全功能管家**

---

## 配置

### 方式 A：OAuth 2.1 授权（推荐）

1. 设置面板中选择 **OAuth 授权** 标签
2. 点「开始 OAuth 授权」
3. 浏览器会打开 Cloudflare 授权页，登录并授权
4. 回调完成后面板状态变为「已连接」

插件使用 **动态客户端注册 + PKCE**，不需要你预先创建 OAuth App。
令牌自动续期，`offline_access` 让刷新令牌长期有效。

### 方式 B：API Token

1. 面板中选择 **API Token** 标签
2. 填入 **Account ID**（控制台右侧「账户 ID」，32 位十六进制）
3. 填入 **API Token**
4. 点「保存并测试连接」

> Token 保存后不再回显，输入框留空表示保留原值。

---

## 🔑 Token 权限清单

Cloudflare **没有**「一键全权限」复选框，必须逐项勾选。要让写操作（部署 Workers、改 DNS、管 R2）可用：

1. 打开 [Dash → My Profile → API Tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens)
2. **Create Custom Token**
3. **Permissions** 区域，把下表中 **Account** 与 **Zone** 两个作用域的权限组设为 `Edit`（不是 `Read`）

| 作用域 | 权限组 | 级别 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Zone | DNS | Edit | 增删改 DNS 记录 |
| Zone | Workers Routes | Edit | 绑定路由 |
| Zone | Zone Settings | Edit | 缓存、SSL 等配置 |
| Account | Workers Scripts | Edit | 部署 / 删除 Worker |
| Account | Cloudflare Pages | Edit | 部署静态站 |
| Account | Workers KV Storage | Edit | 键值存储 |
| Account | D1 | Edit | 数据库 |
| Account | Workers R2 Storage | Edit | 对象存储（需先在控制台开通 R2） |

4. **Account Resources** → `Include` → **All accounts**
5. **Zone Resources** → `Include` → **All zones**
6. 保存后立刻粘贴到面板，点「保存并测试连接」

> **只给 `Read` 会怎样？** 列表、查询能过，但部署、改记录、建桶会全部返回 `403`。

---

## 使用

连接成功后，直接用自然语言对话即可：

```
列一下我账号下所有的 Zone
→ execute: GET /zones

给 example.com 加一条 A 记录，指向 1.2.3.4
→ search 找到 POST /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records
→ execute 创建

把这个目录部署到 Workers
→ search 找到上传会话与部署端点
→ execute 分步上传并部署

我的 D1 里有多少张表？
→ execute: POST /accounts/{id}/d1/database/{db}/query
```

模型会先用 `search` 查规格、再用 `execute` 执行——**不需要你记任何 API 路径**。

---

## 配置项

`cordis.patch.yml` 中本插件行支持的字段：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `port` | `18923` | 本地代理监听端口（仅绑定 `127.0.0.1`） |

> 改端口后必须同步修改同一文件里 `cloudflare-codemode-mcp` 行的 `url`。

凭据文件：`~/.dsh/dsh-cloudflare-codemode.json`（权限 `0600`）

```jsonc
{
  "authMode": "oauth",        // "oauth" | "token"
  "accountId": "…32 位十六进制…",
  "apiToken": "…",            // authMode=token 时使用
  "oauth": {                  // authMode=oauth 时使用
    "clientId": "…",
    "accessToken": "…",
    "refreshToken": "…",
    "expiresAt": 1792523692052
  }
}
```

---

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 面板显示「未连接」，工具列表为空 | 尚未配置凭据。填入 Token 或完成 OAuth 后等待约 30 秒（桥接有重连间隔）。 |
| 保存了 Token 但工具一直不出现 | 检查是否已重启 DSH。首次启动时若还没有凭据，桥接会持续重试（预算已设为 2000 次，约 8 小时）。 |
| 面板报「Cloudflare 拒绝了当前凭据（401）」 | Token 失效或被吊销，重新授权。 |
| 某个操作返回 `403` | Token 权限不足，按上面的[权限清单](#-token-权限清单)补齐对应的 `Edit` 权限。 |
| R2 操作报 `10042` | R2 未在该账户开通，需先去 [R2 控制台](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/r2) 启用。 |
| 端口 18923 被占用 | 修改 `cordis.patch.yml` 中两处端口后重启。 |

查看实时状态（本机）：

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:18923/cloudflare-codemode/state
```

---

## 安全

- **凭据只存本机**：`~/.dsh/dsh-cloudflare-codemode.json`，权限 `0600`，永不写入 profile 配置。
- **代理只绑回环**：`127.0.0.1:18923`，不对外网开放。设置面板路由校验同源，拒绝跨站请求。
- **OAuth 令牌自动刷新**：刷新失败会明确报错，不会静默降级。
- **不收集任何数据**：没有遥测，没有第三方中转。请求只在你、本机代理与 Cloudflare 之间流动。
- **面板永不回显 Token**：只显示「已保存 / 未保存」。

> ⚠️ **切勿把 Token 粘贴到聊天窗口或 Issue**。本插件的设计目的之一就是让凭据不经过对话。

---

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 0.2.x（已验证 0.2.1-rc.2） |
| profile | `web`、`desktop` 均可 |
| 平台 | Windows / macOS / Linux |
| Node.js | ≥ 22 |

**不依赖任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时导入**，因此不会被 DSH 的版本闸门拦截，
也不会因为内核升级而失效。唯一的外部依赖是 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`。

---

## 目录结构

```
dsh-cloudflare-codemode/
├── package.json          # 包元数据 + dsh.bundle / dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 两行：本插件 Host 半 + 官方 MCP 客户端
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # Host 半：配置存储、认证代理、设置路由
│   └── client.js         # Client 半：设置面板（纯 __ModuleLoader__，无构建步骤）
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json           # 中文标题与描述
│   └── en.json           # 英文标题与描述
├── icon.svg
└── LICENSE
```

---

## 开发

无需构建步骤。改 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可；改 `lib/index.js` 需重启宿主。

语法检查：

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js
```

---

## 相关链接

- [Cloudflare Code Mode MCP 文档](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/)
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/)

---

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

本项目为独立第三方插件，与 Cloudflare, Inc. 及 DeepSeek 均无隶属或背书关系。
使用本插件访问 Cloudflare API 时，你需自行遵守 Cloudflare 的服务条款。

plugins.description: 在 DSH 输入框统计栏常驻显示渠道积分余额，并按账号归因每轮对话的积分消耗
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-channel-credits 输入框下方统计栏常驻显示渠道积分余额；每轮对话结束后在回合尾部回填本轮积分消耗。 数据全部来自 `dsh-our-free-model` 已注册的 `channel-pack` RPC 服务（`usage.badge` / `provider.status`），不请求任何外部接口，不读凭据文件。 ## 两个挂载点 | 槽位 | 位置 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | `conversation.composer.dock` | 输入框卡片下方统计栏（`⊙ 上下文环` 右侧） | `剩余 9,034 积分`，点击强刷 | | `conversation.chat.turnTail` | 每轮回答末尾的动作行之前 | `本轮 −0.31 积分` | 统计栏条目靠 CSS `order:1` 排到 `activity` / `usage` / `ContextMeter` 之后 —— 那三个 原生条目都没有 `order`（默认 0），所以本插件是这行的最后一个 flex item。 ## 数据口径 - **剩余积分**：宿主 `usage.badge` 返回的 `balance.total` 按 provider 求和。只对 `provider.status` 里 `accounts.total > 0` 的 provider 取数（宿主是逐账号顺序打上游的， 盲目全量轮询会触发风控）。 - **本轮消耗**：宿主和上游都没有任何单次消耗字段，因此用**余额差量**实测：回合刚结束时 强刷一次作为基线，再在 70s / 120s / 180s 采样，取到回落就结算。上游扣账延迟实测 60~100 秒，所以回合结束时读到的必然还是旧值 —— 这也是必须异步回填的原因。 - 结算结果写 `localStorage`（键 `dcc:v1:turn::`），刷新页面不重算。 - 同一会话只允许最新一轮认领差量；0 值也记账，避免重复结算。 ## 依赖的真实接口 ```js connection.rpc.call('/api', 'channel-pack', { method, payload }, signal) ``` - `usage.badge { provider, force }` → `{ accounts: [{ accountId, nickname, balance: { total, packages } }], windowDays }` - `provider.status { providers }` → `{ statuses: {

: { accounts: { total, enabled }, closed } } }` 宿主的徽标缓存 TTL 是 120 秒，插件轮询周期也是 120 秒，`force:true` 只在点击和结算采样时用。 ## 依赖风险（重要） 本插件读的是 **`dsh-our-free-model` 注册的私有 RPC 服务 `channel-pack`**，不是 DSH 官方稳定 API。`dsh-our-free-model` 默认开启热更新（`autoReloadWatch`），上游一旦调整 `usage.badge` / `provider.status` 的方法名、参数或返回结构，插件会静默失效（界面不报错， 只是不显示）。 同理，`dsh-channel-credits` 只适用于**装了 `dsh-our-free-model` 并配置了至少一个渠道账号** 的 DSH 桌面端；没有该插件时 `connection.rpc` 找不到 `channel-pack` 服务，本插件不渲染任何内容。 与 [`dsh-ofm-balance`](https://github.com/Shen-18/dsh-ofm-balance) 的区别：那个在**侧边栏** 列各渠道额度、只做余额展示；本插件在**输入框统计栏**常驻余额，并且对**每一轮对话**回填 积分消耗与具体扣款账号（`本轮 −3.91 积分 · ACAI`）。 ## 已知限制 - 单位混用：`cline` 是美元、`zcode` 是 token、`gemini` 是额度，其余按「积分」显示。 多 provider 合计时只累加同单位条目。 - 凭据缺失的账号（如 `qodercn`）返回 `balance: null` + `error: '凭据未配置'`，界面上 显示为「不可用」，不计入合计。 - 一个回合里如果切换过 provider，差量会算到当前 provider 的合计上。 ## 装配 profile 的 `package.json`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles//package.json`）： - `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-channel-credits": "file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-channel-credits"` （或直接 `dsh plugin add`） - `dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾追加 `"dsh-channel-credits"` 包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入一行 `channel-credits`，客户端半边由 `dsh.client.platform: web` 声明。 **改动需要重启 DSH 桌面端才生效**（cordis 树只在启动时构建）。

plugins.description: 专门用于DSH的人类注意力聚合插件 | 此插件完全由ai开发(人类仅提供想法,未写代码)

# Omni Plan

> 给 DSH 用的全局置顶计划看板：**跨会话防失忆 · 灵感收件箱 · AI 整理 · 一键注入待办**。
> 当前版本：`0.0.3`（公测版） · 仓库：<https://github.com/ives-jz/dsh-plugin-omni-plan>

同时开多个 DSH 窗口、多个 Agent 时，切回来最容易忘记「刚才做到哪、下一步该干嘛」。Omni Plan 把一份**所有会话共享的计划板**放到最上层，并让所有 DSH 会话、Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端读写同一份本地数据。

---

## ✨ 特性

- **真·桌面置顶**：Windows 下启动独立 WPF 原生窗口（`WS_EX_TOPMOST`），可以盖住浏览器、IDE、全屏软件，不进任务栏、不进 Alt+Tab。
- **当前焦点锚点**：记录工作区、AI 状态、AI 正在做什么，以及最重要的「你回来后的下一步」——这就是防失忆的核心。
- **任务看板**：待办 / 进行中 / 阻塞 / 完成，P0–P7 优先级、备注、提醒、勾选完成、行内编辑。
- **灵感收件箱**：人类、DSH Agent、外部 MCP 都能随手追加；一键转成任务。
- **AI 整理**：让当前会话的 AI 直接读取看板、整理成结构化任务并写回；整理指令以折叠卡片注入，不刷屏聊天记录。
- **一键注入待办**：单条注入，或「整理 Omni Plan」窗口勾选批量注入当前会话 DSH Todo，按优先级排序。
- **跨轮保活**：注入的待办在任务完成前会跨轮次保持显示；你或 AI 完成它，它才消失。
- **实时同步**：SSE 推送 `snapshot` / `change` / `reminder` / `warning`，多个窗口、多个进程共享同一份状态。
- **MCP 三接入**：DSH 内置工具、MCP Streamable HTTP、独立 stdio Server。

---

## 🚀 快速开始

### 从插件市场安装（发布后）

```text
DSH 侧边栏 → 插件市场 → 搜索 Omni Plan → 安装
```

或：

```powershell
# 插件市场 / Web profile（市场收录命令）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-omni-plan

# 桌面版 profile（本机实际使用的 profile 名以你的环境为准）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-omni-plan
```

### 本地目录安装（开发 / 测试）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:A:\AI\DSH\dsh-plugin-omni-plan
```

安装或更新后：

- 只改了 Client（`lib/client.js`）→ 刷新一次 DSH Web GUI 即可；
- 改了 Host（`lib/host.js` 等）或原生窗口（`lib/OmniPlanTopmost.exe`）→ **完全退出并重新启动 DSH**。

打开置顶窗口后，看板默认出现在屏幕右上角；窗口可拖拽、折叠、切主题。

---

## 🧭 界面速览

### 顶部「◈ Omni Plan」菜单

- **打开置顶窗口**：启动原生置顶看板；
- **整理 ▸ 全部 / 焦点 / 任务 / 灵感**：把对应范围交给当前会话 AI 整理，并在看板上写回。

### 底栏按钮

| 按钮 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **整理 Omni Plan** | 打开整理窗口：勾选任务直接注入当前会话待办，也可把灵感转任务、新建任务后一起注入 |
| **AI总结** | 复制一段提示词。发给任意 AI，AI 会按指定格式回复；复制回来点「导入」即可解析成任务或灵感 |
| **导入** | 解析剪贴板里 AI 回复的代码块，批量生成任务 / 灵感 |

### 卡片「⋯」菜单

每条焦点 / 任务 / 灵感都有：**复制 · 编辑 · 删除 · 注入对话**。
「注入对话」只注入当前这一条，不会带上其他任务。

---

## 🔁 推荐工作流

```text
记录          →  整理            →  注入              →  完成
灵感/想法         AI 读看板并补全      写入当前会话待办       勾选完成 / AI 标记
进收件箱          成可执行任务         按优先级排序并保活      自动从待办移除
```

1. 有想法先丢进「灵感」——不打断当前 Agent；
2. 点「整理 Omni Plan」或顶部「整理」，让 AI 把它补全成任务；
3. 把要做的注入当前会话待办，AI 和你就有了同一份清单；
4. 做完勾掉，清单自动更新。

---

## 🧰 AI 工具

装好后，所有 DSH 会话自动获得 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `plan_get_overview` | 读取完整看板：焦点、任务、收件箱、summary |
| `plan_upsert_context` | 新增 / 更新焦点锚点 |
| `plan_manage_task` | `add` / `update` / `complete` / `delete` 任务 |
| `plan_capture_idea` | 快速写入收件箱 |
| `plan_apply_organization` | 把 AI 整理结果写回看板 |
| `plan_push_to_dsh_todos` | 把看板任务注入当前会话待办（可按 `itemIds` 选择、按优先级排序） |
| `plan_get_dsh_todos` | 读取当前会话待办（新一轮重置后也能读回最近一次注入） |

在任意 DSH 会话里直接说：

```text
帮我整理 Omni Plan 里的所有内容
```

AI 会先 `plan_get_overview` 读看板，再 `plan_apply_organization` 写回；需要时自动同步到当前会话待办。

---

## 🔌 MCP 接入

### 方式 A：stdio（最稳，Claude Desktop / Cursor / 通用 MCP 客户端）

```powershell
node "<插件目录>\lib\mcp-stdio.js" --data-dir "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\omni-plan"
```

配置示例（`claude_desktop_config.json` / `.cursor/mcp.json`）：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "omni-plan": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "<插件目录>\\lib\\mcp-stdio.js",
        "--data-dir",
        "C:\\Users\\<you>\\.dsh\\omni-plan"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### 方式 B：Streamable HTTP

DSH Web GUI 运行时：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>/omni-plan/mcp
```

如 `cordis.patch.yml` 配了 `mcpToken`，请求需带 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`。

### 方式 C：旧版 HTTP + SSE

```text
GET  /omni-plan/mcp/sse
POST /omni-plan/mcp/messages?sessionId=<id>
```

---

## 🌐 Host HTTP API

```text
GET    /omni-plan/health
GET    /omni-plan/state
GET    /omni-plan/events                  # SSE

POST   /omni-plan/contexts
PATCH  /omni-plan/contexts/:id
DELETE /omni-plan/contexts/:id

POST   /omni-plan/tasks
PATCH  /omni-plan/tasks/:id
DELETE /omni-plan/tasks/:id
POST   /omni-plan/tasks/:id/complete

POST   /omni-plan/inbox
POST   /omni-plan/inbox/:id/promote
DELETE /omni-plan/inbox/:id

POST   /omni-plan/integrations/organize          # AI 整理
POST   /omni-plan/integrations/dsh-todos/push    # 注入会话待办

POST   /omni-plan/mcp                            # MCP Streamable HTTP
GET    /omni-plan/mcp/sse                        # MCP legacy SSE
POST   /omni-plan/mcp/messages                   # MCP legacy POST

GET    /omni-plan/topmost                        # 原生置顶窗口状态
POST   /omni-plan/topmost                        # 打开
POST   /omni-plan/topmost/close                  # 关闭
```

SSE 事件：`snapshot`（连接时全量）、`change`（增量 + revision）、`reminder`（到期提醒）、`warning`（存储告警）。

---

## 🔒 数据与隐私

- 数据只在本机：`~/.dsh/omni-plan/state.json`，不上传任何服务器；
- 写入使用 `state.json.lock` 排他锁 + 临时文件原子替换，损坏时自动备份重建；
- 插件包内**不包含**任何用户数据、测试任务或日志；
- MCP 默认只监听本机；需要时可用 `mcpToken` 加 Bearer 校验。

---

## ⚙️ 配置

`cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: omni-plan
      name: dsh-plugin-omni-plan
      config:
        dataDir: ''            # 空 = ~/.dsh/omni-plan
        pollIntervalMs: 500
        sseHeartbeatMs: 15000
        reminderPollMs: 5000
        mcpHttp: true
        # mcpToken: 'optional-shared-secret'
        # trustedHosts: 'localhost:13304,127.0.0.1:13304'
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dataDir` | `''` | 数据目录，空字符串用默认路径 |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `500` | `fs.watch` 失败时的轮询兜底 |
| `sseHeartbeatMs` | `15000` | SSE 心跳间隔 |
| `reminderPollMs` | `5000` | 提醒扫描间隔 |
| `mcpHttp` | `true` | 是否暴露 HTTP/SSE MCP |
| `mcpToken` | 空 | 可选 Bearer token |
| `trustedHosts` | 空 | 额外信任的 Host authority |

---

## 🖥️ 原生置顶说明

Windows 下，插件启动独立 WPF 进程 `OmniPlanTopmost.exe`：

- `Topmost=true` + `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`：覆盖其他窗口、不进任务栏、不进 Alt+Tab；
- 三页切换：焦点 / 任务 / 灵感；每条内容独立「注入对话 / 复制 / 编辑 / 删除」；
- 与 DSH 完全解耦，数据通过本机 REST + 轮询读写同一份 `state.json`；
- 启动失败会写 `~/.dsh/omni-plan/topmost.log`。

非 Windows 或原生启动不可用时，回退到 Document Picture-in-Picture / popup。

---

## 🛠️ 开发

```powershell
# 语法检查
node --check lib\host.js
node --check lib\client.js
node --check lib\store.js
node --check lib\mcp-stdio.js

# 重新编译原生窗口（Windows）
$ref = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Reference Assemblies\Microsoft\Framework\.NETFramework\v4.7.2'
& 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe' /nologo /target:winexe `
  /out:'lib\OmniPlanTopmost.exe' `
  "/r:$ref\PresentationFramework.dll" "/r:$ref\PresentationCore.dll" `
  "/r:$ref\WindowsBase.dll" "/r:$ref\System.Xaml.dll" `
  'lib\OmniPlanTopmost.cs'

# 本地安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<插件目录>
```

```powershell
npm publish --access public --tag latest
```
